nodes.title: Entity provenance and audit-trail surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-B2C85448 covering the provenance + audit-trail implementation surface. Components: libs/ner/span_resolver.py (character offsets, DI-B2512CB3), :Entity snippet_hash on document writes (tamper detection, DI-B2512CB3), services/ui review highlight renderer (DI-E81545BE), libs/ner/context_engine.py assertion evidence windows (DI-23822663), CodingReview correction event schema + services/api correction endpoints (DI-4F67189B), services/api/app/routers/audit.py + services/fhir_api/app/routers/audit_event.py audit trail APIs (DI-09E26C1D). Code-gap (tracked in improvements-backlog): append-only write-once enforcement + 7-year retention policy engine for DI-080A2454 - current retention is infra-level not application-enforced.

nodes.title: Immutable source-span linkage and provenance for extracted entities
nodes.description: Each AI-extracted entity SHALL store the exact source text span, model or rule identifier, confidence, assertion context, and an integrity hash that rejects post-hoc edits.

nodes.title: Source-text highlight linking for reviewer entity selection
nodes.description: The system SHALL render the source clinical text for each extracted entity when a reviewer selects that entity, with the specific character span that generated the entity highlighted; the highlight SHALL correspond exactly to the character offsets stored in the provenance record.

nodes.title: Assertion evidence text context stored alongside assertion label
nodes.description: The system SHALL store alongside each assertion label the verbatim text window that the assertion model evaluated to determine that label, so that a reviewer can read the textual evidence for the assertion without needing to re-read the full source document.

nodes.title: Provenance record immutable retention policy enforcement (7-year minimum)
nodes.description: The system SHALL retain all extraction provenance records in an immutable, append-only store for a minimum of 7 years from the date of creation, and SHALL enforce a write-once policy that rejects any update or delete operation on a provenance record within the retention window.

nodes.title: Reviewer correction event schema immutably linked to extraction provenance
nodes.description: The system SHALL record every reviewer coding correction as an immutable event appended to the extraction provenance record, containing the original code, replacement code, correction rationale, reviewer identity and role, and timestamp.

nodes.title: Audit trail API providing provenance access without clinical record exposure
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a dedicated audit trail API endpoint that returns extraction provenance records, assertion evidence, and correction events for authorised auditors without exposing the underlying clinical record free-text or patient identifiable data.

nodes.title: Knowledge base authoring and staging surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO covering guideline authoring, conflict detection, staged promotion, deprecation closure, surface form dict, reference range library, and ConText rule management. UNs: UN-407F090F, UN-4BD56518, UN-B9FDC3CA, UN-E8A5B04A, UN-06388412. Components in services/terminology_api + services/knowledge_api + services/ui knowledge authoring views. Code-gap: some staging gates are manual pending full change-control UI.

nodes.title: Guideline deprecation dependency closure enforcement
nodes.description: The system SHALL enumerate all dependent artefacts for a guideline and SHALL prevent deprecation until each dependency is migrated or explicitly waived with recorded rationale.

nodes.title: Guideline authoring with mandatory source linkage and staged promotion
nodes.description: The authoring tool SHALL block save-to-active unless each guideline entry cites an authoritative source identifier and passes the configured review stage gates.

nodes.title: Guideline conflict detection before staging with under-review status preserving active availability
nodes.description: The system SHALL detect and flag conflicts between proposed guideline updates and active entries with required resolution before staging, and SHALL support an under-review status that preserves active availability while indicating review in progress to end users.

nodes.title: Guideline withdrawal notification to prior users and permanent audit-trail retention of deprecated entries
nodes.description: The system SHALL notify clinical end users of guideline withdrawals with superseding content references, and SHALL retain deprecated guideline entries permanently in the audit record with withdrawal metadata linked to the associated change request.

nodes.title: Reference range CRUD: structured entry with mandatory source traceability and unit of measure
nodes.description: The system SHALL store reference range entries with all of: investigation type SNOMED concept, lower bound, upper bound per band (normal, borderline, critical), unit of measure, source document name, source version, and effective date, rejecting entries with missing mandatory fields at save.

nodes.title: Reference range change control gate: activation blocked without approval record
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that any addition, modification, or retirement of a reference range entry passes through the clinical change control approval workflow before the change is activated, blocking activation at the data layer if no approval record exists.

nodes.title: Reference ranges included in content currency dashboard with review status
nodes.description: The system SHALL include all active reference range entries in the content currency dashboard with their last verified date, next review due date, and a status of current, due, or overdue, consistent with the governance model applied to other clinical content components.

nodes.title: Surface form change gate: staging, review approval, versioning, and rollback
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a staging and review gate for all surface form changes, requiring a recorded approval before activation, and SHALL maintain a full version history of active surface form sets enabling rollback to any prior version with a recorded rollback event.

nodes.title: ConText rule management: full parameter CRUD with test-run gate before activation
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a ConText rule management interface covering trigger phrase, assertion type (present, absent, uncertain, historical, family, hypothetical), scope direction, window size, and pseudo-trigger exceptions, requiring a passed verification test run before activation of any rule set change.

nodes.title: ConText rule change: pre-save assertion distribution impact report against held-out corpus
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute the assertion distribution impact of a proposed ConText rule change against the held-out test corpus before the change is saved, displaying the delta in assertion type counts relative to the current active rule set and storing the impact report with the change record.

nodes.title: Auth, role-state and tenant-scope middleware
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the authN/authZ surface: `libs/auth/role_state.py` (RoleState, canonical role set, selected-role workflow), `libs/auth/tenant_context.py` (tenant scope), `libs/auth/practitioner_org_context.py` (clinician-org binding), `libs/auth/service_auth.py`, `libs/auth/org_scope.py`, and `services/api/app/routers/auth.py`. Azure Key Vault-backed secrets (`libs/keyvault/loader.py`, `libs/azure/credentials.py`).

Gaps (batch-15 Theme B/C): formalised token lifecycle documentation (UN-A031A603), explicit conflict-of-interest attestation artefact per review (UN-17724530), and physical database-level tenant separation (UN-412D1ECD currently implemented as logical tenant-scoped Cypher rather than per-tenant DB). Backlogged.

nodes.title: Credential scope and conflict checks before approval actions
nodes.description: The system SHALL deny approval actions unless the authenticated principal holds an active credential covering the clinical scope of the change and has no recorded conflict of interest for that item.

nodes.title: OAuth2/OIDC-aligned authentication with documented scopes and token lifetimes
nodes.description: The identity service SHALL implement OAuth2 or OIDC-aligned client credentials and authorization code flows with published scope strings, access token TTL, refresh rules, and rotation behaviour.

nodes.title: Reviewer self-approval prevention and administrator-only credential profile management with full audit logging
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce reviewer self-approval prevention at the API layer, restrict credential profile management to the administrator role, and audit log all credential assignments and changes.

nodes.title: Isolated test credential environment with per-scope credentials and full OAuth 2.0/OIDC flow support
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a test credential environment isolated from production patient data, supporting the full OAuth 2.0/OIDC auth flow with one test credential per scope, and covered by the sandbox version-alignment lag policy.

nodes.title: Multi-tenancy: dedicated Neo4j patient graph per tenant with automated provisioning
nodes.description: The system SHALL assign each tenant a dedicated Neo4j patient graph instance with no shared patient data nodes, and SHALL provide an automated provisioning script that creates the dedicated instance, credentials, and Key Vault secrets as an idempotent operation.

nodes.title: Multi-tenancy: tenant token validation before query execution with architecturally enforced single-driver scoping
nodes.description: The system SHALL validate the tenant context token on every API request before any Cypher query executes, return a 401 for missing or invalid tokens, and construct all Cypher query builders to accept only a single driver connection scoped to the requesting tenant, with cross-tenant access verified as architecturally impossible by automated test.

nodes.title: Surface forms CRUD with duplicate audit and match frequency
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the Settings > Surface Forms management surface across API (`services/terminology_api/app/routers/surface_forms.py`), Cypher (`services/terminology_api/app/queries/terminology.py` AUDIT_SURFACE_FORM_DUPLICATES, DEDUPLICATE_SURFACE_FORM_RELS, LIST/GROUPED/UPSERT/DELETE_SURFACE_FORM*), and the UI page at `services/ui/src/app/settings/surface-forms/page.tsx`.

Covers DI-30D95132 (CRUD + duplicate rejection + match frequency via grouped list). Duplicate audit queries expose mappings that conflict on (text, concept_id) and support dedup/merge operations.

Gap (DI-9FD54AD6, tracked in improvements-backlog batch-08): no staging -> approval -> versioned-rollout workflow; writes go directly to active KG.

nodes.title: Surface form CRUD interface with match frequency display and duplicate rejection
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a CRUD management interface for surface form entries, with each entry storing text expression, SNOMED concept ID, confidence score, and source, displaying the match frequency from recent pipeline runs, and rejecting duplicate text-concept pairs at save.

nodes.title: Guideline update review surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-16E151CB covering side-by-side version comparison, independent conformance checks, and safety checks on guideline updates.

nodes.title: Independent source conformance and safety checks for guideline updates
nodes.description: The change review workflow SHALL require separate recorded outcomes for source-text conformance and implementation safety before a guideline update can be promoted to active content.

nodes.title: Guideline update review: side-by-side version comparison with source navigation and affected rules enumeration
nodes.description: The system SHALL present a side-by-side version comparison view for guideline updates, display the source reference with a navigable link, and enumerate all pathway rules and decision logic affected by the update within the review workflow.

nodes.title: Data-gap disclosure and small-cohort suppression surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-A949A642 data-gap disclosure. Components: services/analytics_api coverage service (DI-00E16F9E, DI-88F20177), small-cohort suppression logic (DI-CB3DF3E1), disclosure banner in services/ui (DI-0D7DCC52).

nodes.title: Mandatory acknowledgement gate for coverage and data-gap warnings
nodes.description: The system SHALL require explicit clinician acknowledgement before any primary clinical action can proceed when a coverage indicator is below the configured floor or a data-gap warning is active; the acknowledgement SHALL be logged with reviewer identity, timestamp, and the warning state that triggered it.

nodes.title: Data-gap detection and mandatory disclosure for clinician-facing outputs derived from incomplete data
nodes.description: The system SHALL detect when source data required to generate a clinician-facing output is partially or fully absent and SHALL either withhold the output or present it with a visible, plain-language data-gap warning that specifies the missing data fields; silent partial outputs without disclosure are prohibited.

nodes.title: Small-cohort output suppression and low-confidence flagging
nodes.description: The system SHALL suppress or flag with an explicit low-confidence warning any cohort-based output where the matched patient cohort is smaller than the configured minimum size threshold; the warning SHALL state the actual cohort size and the threshold applied, and SHALL prevent primary clinical actions until acknowledged.

nodes.title: Programme-level configuration of completeness and suppression thresholds
nodes.description: The system SHALL store all data completeness thresholds, cohort minimum sizes, and data-gap warning floor values as named programme-level configuration parameters that can be changed by an administrator without code deployment; all changes SHALL be audit logged.

nodes.title: Developer integration surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO covering async job pattern, stable error envelope, sandbox environment, semantic versioning + deprecation headers, OpenAPI + changelog, and onboarding wizard. UNs: UN-395B630E, UN-F2372DE0, UN-9A7C2AA3, UN-21D88B69, UN-718B7AF3, UN-16116C5F. Components: services/api routers, sandbox infra, generated OpenAPI, services/ui onboarding wizard.

nodes.title: Semantic versioning policy with published deprecation notices
nodes.description: The platform SHALL publish and follow semantic versioning for public APIs, announce deprecations with at least the minimum notice period, and maintain a compatibility matrix per release.

nodes.title: Consistent async job API with documented lifecycle and webhooks
nodes.description: All long-running operations SHALL use the standard job resource pattern with documented status transitions, polling contract, and optional webhook delivery for terminal states.

nodes.title: Machine-readable OpenAPI for every public API version
nodes.description: The platform SHALL publish a complete OpenAPI document for each supported API major.minor version before that version is marked generally available.

nodes.title: Sandbox tenant with synthetic data and fault injection controls
nodes.description: The platform SHALL provide an isolated sandbox tenant using synthetic patients, parity-equivalent services, and administrator-triggered fault injection for integration testing.

nodes.title: Stable JSON error envelope with machine-readable error codes
nodes.description: All error responses SHALL return the standard JSON envelope with HTTP status, machine-readable error code, human-readable message, correlation identifier, and optional detail object.

nodes.title: Deprecation and sunset response headers with integrator notification subscription for deprecated endpoints
nodes.description: The system SHALL include `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers on all deprecated endpoints, and SHALL provide a notification subscription mechanism for integrators to receive deprecation announcements without active API monitoring.

nodes.title: Job status responses include elapsed time, estimated completion, current step name, and support cancellation
nodes.description: The system SHALL include elapsed time, estimated completion time (where calculable), and current pipeline step name in job status responses, and SHALL support job cancellation with confirmed outcome via the status model.

nodes.title: Partial job result surfacing per completed pipeline step before overall job completion
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface partial job results via the status endpoint as each pipeline step completes, allowing consuming products to process available data without waiting for full job completion.

nodes.title: Human-readable API reference and versioned changelog co-published with each API release
nodes.description: The system SHALL co-publish a human-readable API reference and a versioned changelog alongside each machine-readable OpenAPI release, with version status markers enabling developers to identify current, stable, and deprecated versions.

nodes.title: Sandbox version-alignment with production within documented lag window and synthetic-only patient data guarantee
nodes.description: The system SHALL keep the sandbox version-aligned with production within a documented lag window, surface version-lag state via API header, and guarantee all sandbox patient data is synthetic with no real NHS identifiers.

nodes.title: Versioned error reference table with three-category classification and remediation paths for developer-actionable errors
nodes.description: The system SHALL publish a versioned error reference table classifying all error codes into client/server/clinical data categories, with remediation paths for actionable errors, co-versioned with the API specification.

nodes.title: Onboarding checklist: six mandatory steps with completion recording and programme activation gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a six-step onboarding checklist covering org creation, tenant provisioning, FHIR endpoint registration, programme selection, user role assignment, and first pipeline test run, recording completion timestamp and user identity on each step, and blocking programme activation until all steps are confirmed.

nodes.title: Onboarding: resumable state persisted across sessions with admin dashboard progress indicator
nodes.description: The system SHALL persist onboarding state across sessions and allow any administrator for the organisation to resume an incomplete onboarding, with the current progress visible on the admin dashboard.

nodes.title: Model registry canary lifecycle and promotion gate
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `libs/model_registry/registry.py`: canary state machine (registered -> offline_validated -> canary -> promoted -> rollback/deprecated), promotion gate using aggregate canary precision + recall thresholds (_MIN_CANARY_PRECISION, _MIN_CANARY_RECALL), cohort tagging via canary_cohort, rollback_target_version storage.

Gaps (improvements-backlog batch-07):
- DI-A557AE91: no runtime traffic-split mechanism. Inference always serves the single active version.
- DI-7D710C52: rollback is manual; no per-entity-type F1 threshold check; gate is aggregate P+R only.

nodes.title: Model canary: configurable traffic split with audit trail tagging of canary runs
nodes.description: The system SHALL route a configurable percentage of pipeline runs to a candidate model version while the remainder continue to use the current production model, tagging all canary-assigned runs with the candidate model version and run type in the audit trail.

nodes.title: Model canary: automatic halt and production rollback on per-entity F1 regression
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically halt a canary and reinstate the production model when F1 for any entity type drops below a configurable per-entity threshold, writing the rollback event to the audit trail with the entity type, F1 delta, and timestamp.

nodes.title: Disorder verifier v2 with fail-closed GATE_FAILED verdict (libs/llm_client/disorder_verifier.py)
nodes.description: DisorderVerdict enum extended with GATE_FAILED member. _fail_verdict_for_mode() simplified to return GATE_FAILED for all modes (HITL, autonomous, unknown). verify_disorder() records disorder_verdict on the entity, and on GATE_FAILED sets __needs_review__=True and __gate_failed__=True to prevent silent auto-coding. Post-processing stack handles GATE_FAILED explicitly in _apply_disorder_gate.

nodes.title: Disorder gate fail-closed with GATE_FAILED verdict
nodes.description: The disorder verifier SHALL record a DisorderVerdict.GATE_FAILED result on any provider failure, parse failure, or consensus disagreement that cannot be resolved. When GATE_FAILED is raised the entity SHALL be marked __needs_review__ and __gate_failed__ and SHALL NOT be eligible for autonomous coding in any mode (HITL, autonomous, or unknown). The verdict SHALL also be recorded on the entity as disorder_verdict for downstream audit.

nodes.title: Platform architecture, AI model registry, and CI quality gates
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-2C6E6933 platform foundations. Components: libs/pipeline_graph LangGraph-style executor and tool registry (DI-A90B19EB, DI-3FDBB57B), Neo4j-stored AI model registry and prompt templates (DI-2C56591B), Azure Key Vault secrets handling via config loader (DI-6EBF12F1), .github/workflows CI pipelines running black + flake8 (DI-932C270C), code-quality.mdc function-length enforcement (DI-693FFEEA). Code-gap flagged: automated function-length CI check not yet wired; currently enforced by review.

nodes.title: All pipeline and workflow logic defined as graph data and executed by a single generic executor
nodes.description: The system SHALL define all pipeline and workflow logic as graph data stored as WorkflowDefinition and WorkflowStep nodes in the primary database, and SHALL execute all workflows through a single generic executor that reads step definitions at runtime, so that new workflows and pipeline configurations can be added by inserting graph data without any code changes or deployments.

nodes.title: Unified LangGraph coding agent as the single execution path for all coding and pipeline jobs
nodes.description: The system SHALL use a single unified LangGraph-based coding and audit agent as the exclusive runtime execution path for all clinical coding and pipeline jobs, with the training and runtime pipelines sharing the same post-processing functions, so that there is no divergence between paths and all coding outputs are traceable to a single versioned agent definition.

nodes.title: AI model configurations stored as graph nodes with runtime resolution and no hardcoded model names
nodes.description: The system SHALL store all AI model configurations as AIModel nodes in the graph database and SHALL resolve model parameters at runtime from these nodes; no model names or provider parameters SHALL be hardcoded in application code.

nodes.title: All secrets retrieved exclusively from Azure Key Vault with CI secret scanning and startup failure on missing secrets
nodes.description: The system SHALL retrieve all secrets exclusively from Azure Key Vault using DefaultAzureCredential; no secrets SHALL appear in source code, committed environment files, or container images; services SHALL exit on secret retrieval failure.

nodes.title: CI-enforced code quality gates: black, flake8, ESLint with function and file length limits
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce automated code quality checks in CI: black formatting and flake8 linting for Python, ESLint for TypeScript, with function and file length limits; any violation blocks the merge pipeline.

nodes.title: Async fire-and-track job pattern with consistent status model for all long-running operations
nodes.description: The system SHALL implement a consistent async fire-and-track pattern for all long-running operations, with 202 responses, job_id-based polling, persistent job state, and a uniform status model across all operation types.

nodes.title: Safety-net detector, persistence and pipeline subgraph
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the safety-netting surface: `services/analysis_worker/app/analyzers/safety_net_detector.py`, `safety_net_persistence.py`, pipeline subgraph `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/safety_net.py`, reference-range seeding in `scripts/seed_reference_ranges.py`, and near-miss cleanup in `scripts/delete_near_miss_alerts.py`.

Gaps (batch-13 theme C): three-band severity classification is implemented but configurable follow-up window worklist, auto-suppression on confirmed clinical response, and immutable clinician-id action recording are partial; see improvements-backlog.

nodes.title: Safety netting: result-to-reference-range comparison with three-band severity classification
nodes.description: The system SHALL compare each extracted investigation result value against the active reference range for that investigation type and assign a severity band of normal, borderline, or critical, persisting the band classification on the finding node alongside the result value and the reference range version used.

nodes.title: Safety netting: configurable follow-up time window with worklist of outstanding flagged findings
nodes.description: The system SHALL maintain a safety netting worklist containing all findings classified as borderline or critical where no coded clinical response has been recorded within a configurable time window, surfacing each entry with patient identifier, finding type, severity band, result date, and days outstanding.

nodes.title: Safety netting: immutable action recording with clinician identity and timestamp
nodes.description: The system SHALL allow a clinician to record, amend, and close a safety netting action against any flagged finding, writing the action type, free-text note, clinician identity, and timestamp immutably to the audit trail, with amendments creating a new audit record rather than overwriting the prior entry.

nodes.title: Safety netting: worklist filter by severity, days outstanding, and patient cohort
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide worklist filter controls allowing a clinician to filter safety netting entries by severity band, days outstanding bucket, and patient cohort, with filter state preserved for the duration of the session.

nodes.title: Safety netting: automatic alert suppression on confirmed coded clinical response
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically suppress a safety netting alert when a coded clinical response of an approved type is recorded against the flagged finding, writing the suppression event to the audit trail, and SHALL require a recorded rationale for any manual override of a suppressed alert.

nodes.title: NLP training, audit agent, and FHIR exposure surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for active learning + model improvement cycle, audit agent with bounded auto-fix, benchmark charts in audit exports, FHIR R4 downstream exposure, pathway interval calculations, episode validation, and end-to-end single-patient pipeline SLA. UNs: UN-5236129E, UN-1AC15812, UN-299200A0, UN-94833CA3, UN-5C67AAD9, UN-2C01CF40. Components: libs/training, libs/audit_agent, services/fhir_api, services/coding_worker pipeline.

nodes.title: End-to-end single-patient pipeline processing within 10 seconds at the 95th percentile
nodes.description: The system SHALL complete the full pipeline processing cycle for a single patient — including FHIR record retrieval, NLP entity extraction, guideline evaluation, episode construction, and quality validation — within 10 seconds at the 95th percentile under normal operating conditions.

nodes.title: Automated training-label audit with bounded auto-fix and review queues
nodes.description: The system SHALL scan training labels for defined defect classes, apply only auto-fix rules marked safe, and route all other defects to the human review queue with reasons.

nodes.title: Benchmark comparison charts in audit exports
nodes.description: The audit report generator SHALL include interpretable charts comparing local metrics to national benchmarks with axis labels, units, cohort definitions, and data freshness dates.

nodes.title: Model improvement cycle with active learning, metrics, golden gate, and warm start
nodes.description: The training orchestration SHALL prioritise labelling candidates via the configured active learning policy, compute per-entity F1 on the frozen golden set, block promotion when below threshold, and support warm-start from the last promoted model artifact.

nodes.title: Safety gate: SNOMED coding defects in training labels always routed to human review, never auto-corrected
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that SNOMED coding defects in training labels are never auto-corrected by the audit agent; they SHALL always be routed to the human review queue, while non-SNOMED defects in the safe-fix rule set may be auto-corrected.

nodes.title: Audit agent resource bounds: configurable iteration limit and token/cost budget enforcement
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce configurable per-record tool-use iteration limits and per-run token and cost budgets on the training label audit agent, halting and alerting when any limit is breached.

nodes.title: Span realignment and offset validation on training export with misaligned annotation exclusion
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply span realignment to every annotation in a training export, recomputing character offsets from surface text, and SHALL exclude misaligned annotations from the export with a structured log entry.

nodes.title: Benchmark chart rendering: three-state colour scheme, delta labels, WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, human-readable labels
nodes.description: The system SHALL render benchmark comparison charts with a three-state colour scheme plus delta labels, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant colours, and human-readable programme labels drawn from configuration.

nodes.title: Per-entity-type precision/recall/F1 metrics stored per training job and accessible via model registry
nodes.description: The system SHALL produce and store per-entity-type precision/recall/F1 metrics for every training job, linked to the training job ID, accessible via the model registry API and UI without aggregation.

nodes.title: FHIR R4: coded findings as Observation, milestones as EpisodeOfCare, audit results as MeasureReport with meta.source provenance
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose coded clinical findings as UK Core-conformant FHIR Observation resources, pathway milestones as FHIR EpisodeOfCare resources, and clinical audit results as FHIR MeasureReport resources linked to Measure definitions, with every resource including a meta.source element identifying the generating LEO Core AI version and tenant.

nodes.title: FHIR: capability statement at /fhir/metadata and CI FHIR validator against UK Core profiles
nodes.description: The system SHALL publish a FHIR capability statement at GET /fhir/metadata, and SHALL run the FHIR validator against all generated FHIR resources as a blocking CI step, validating conformance against UK Core profiles for Observation and EpisodeOfCare.

nodes.title: De-identification library + deid validator guard
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the data-protection surface: `libs/deid/deid.py`, `libs/utils/deidentify.py`, `libs/pipeline_graph/utils/deidentify.py`, `libs/ner/deid_validator.py`, and the encounter-coding agent's deid call. Provides regex-based NHS-identifier, postcode, DOB and name redaction with an injectable organisation pattern, and a validator that prevents PHI leaking into downstream LLM prompts.

Gaps (batch-15 Theme A): protected evaluation holdout corpus enforcement (UN-70A35225) and measured recall against a labelled PHI corpus (UN-C2F187E9 acceptance criterion ~99.9% PII recall) are not verified in CI. Backlogged.

nodes.title: Physical separation of patient data and terminology data into distinct database instances
nodes.description: The system SHALL store patient clinical data and clinical terminology data in physically separate database instances with separate credentials, with no direct database-level connections between them, so that a compromise or failure of the terminology database cannot expose or corrupt patient data.

nodes.title: Patient data encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 minimum
nodes.description: The system SHALL encrypt all patient clinical data at rest using AES-256 or equivalent, and SHALL transmit all patient data over TLS 1.2 or higher, with all encryption keys managed exclusively via Azure Key Vault, so that patient data is protected against interception and unauthorised access at the storage and transport layers.

nodes.title: De-identified training corpus with immutable holdout separation
nodes.description: The data platform SHALL enforce separation between training exports and the protected holdout evaluation set such that holdout records cannot be included in training pipelines.

nodes.title: PII detection gate: training export aborted and logged if patient identifiers detected
nodes.description: The system SHALL execute a PII detection scan on every training export and SHALL abort the export job with a structured error log entry if any patient identifiers are detected, without writing the output file.

nodes.title: Training corpus stratification report with safety-critical entity count quality gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate a corpus stratification report before each training run and SHALL block training with a descriptive error if any designated safety-critical entity type has fewer training examples than the configured minimum threshold.

nodes.title: Mandatory pre-LLM de-identification safety gate enforced in LLM client wrapper with bypass prevention
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a mandatory de-identification step as the first transform in every external LLM API call, implemented in the LLM client wrapper so that no caller can bypass it; the step SHALL detect and replace direct patient identifiers before text is transmitted.

nodes.title: Reversible de-identification placeholder substitution with in-memory session mapping
nodes.description: The system SHALL implement reversible placeholder substitution for patient identifiers, replacing each detected identifier with a typed placeholder token and restoring original values from an in-memory session mapping when processing LLM responses.

nodes.title: Operations, admin, DQ, and override analytics surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for Mission Control dashboard, Intelligence Console, config validation/dry-run, DQ engine, audit programme config, AI spend tracking, cohort builder, and override taxonomy/analytics. UNs: UN-BB817C74, UN-3376B57D, UN-4DCD5891, UN-7294050B, UN-9E66C163, UN-FB2DA651, UN-66396DEA, UN-6C8AEB83. Components: services/analytics_api + services/ui admin views.

nodes.title: Unified Intelligence Console with stage health and next action
nodes.description: The admin UI SHALL present all model-improvement stages in one console with health indicators and a single recommended next action per failing stage.

nodes.title: Pipeline configuration dry-run validation before activation
nodes.description: The admin workflow SHALL run the full configured pipeline on approved sample inputs in isolated test mode and SHALL block activation on validation failures or unresolved errors.

nodes.title: Structured override taxonomy capture on every coding correction
nodes.description: The review UI SHALL require a structured error category and optional free text when a user overrides an AI coding proposal, and SHALL store both with the audit record.

nodes.title: Data-driven audit programme configuration without deployment
nodes.description: New audit programmes SHALL be creatable by authoring graph configuration and workflow bindings through the admin interface without a software deployment.

nodes.title: Per-tenant AI usage accounting and configurable commercial rates
nodes.description: The billing console SHALL aggregate token or call usage per tenant, apply configurable rates and discounts, and separate platform operating costs from billable usage in exported reports.

nodes.title: Override analytics dashboard with category distribution, trends, and reviewer role breakdown
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide an override analytics dashboard showing override rate, error category distribution, time trend, and reviewer role breakdown, with filterable CSV export for model improvement analysis.

nodes.title: Runtime-configurable override error category taxonomy with version tracking
nodes.description: The system SHALL store override error category taxonomies as versioned, runtime-configurable data accessible to engineering team administrators, supporting multi-select at the point of override, with each override record storing the taxonomy version used.

nodes.title: Global active training job indicator visible from all admin pages
nodes.description: The system SHALL display a persistent, globally-visible training job status indicator on every admin page while a training job is running, navigating to the job detail view on click.

nodes.title: Programme configuration hot-reload: changes take effect at next run without service restart
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply programme configuration changes without a service restart or deployment; changes SHALL take effect at the start of the next pipeline run for the affected programme.

nodes.title: UI-only pipeline configuration editing with override gate for failed test mode promotions
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose all pipeline configuration fields as UI form controls and SHALL require a recorded authorised override decision before a configuration that failed test mode can be promoted to active for a live tenant.

nodes.title: Configurable margin-derived pricing with per-tenant discounts, 100% discount cap, and immutable pricing change log
nodes.description: The system SHALL derive list prices from a configurable margin target, support per-tenant time-limited and perpetual discounts applied without code deployment, cap total discounts at 100%, and immutably log all pricing changes.

nodes.title: Cohort builder: rule-based inclusion/exclusion across coded entities, pathway stage, and demographics
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a cohort builder interface accepting inclusion/exclusion rules over SNOMED coded entities, pathway stages, demographic attributes (age band, sex, IMD decile), and episode attributes, combining rules with AND/OR logic and displaying the matching patient count before the cohort is saved.

nodes.title: Cohort versioning: each edit creates a new version recorded on all dependent runs
nodes.description: The system SHALL version cohort definitions such that each modification creates a new version without altering prior versions, and SHALL record the specific cohort version used on each analytics or research mission run for reproducibility.

nodes.title: Mission Control: per-programme per-tenant pipeline KPI dashboard with auto-refresh
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide an operational dashboard displaying per-programme, per-tenant pipeline KPIs including encounter queue depth, processing success/failure rate, episode build status, and last completed run timestamp, refreshing automatically on a configurable interval and surfacing no patient-identifiable data.

nodes.title: Mission Control: failed encounter list with failure reason and one-click re-queue
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface failed and stalled encounters in the operations dashboard with failure reason, failure timestamp, and programme, providing a one-click re-queue action per encounter with the re-queue event written to the audit trail including operator identity.

nodes.title: DQ engine: configurable rules with per-episode persistence of pass/fail and remediation recommendation
nodes.description: The system SHALL evaluate each processed episode against a configurable DQ rule set covering completeness, coding consistency, terminology currency, and duplicate detection, persisting per-episode, per-rule results with pass/fail status and a remediation recommendation, with new rules addable via configuration.

nodes.title: DQ sitrep dashboard: pass rate aggregation by rule/programme/tenant with trend and CSV export
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a DQ sitrep dashboard aggregating pass rates per rule, per programme, and per tenant with trend over time, supporting targeted remediation pass execution per rule/programme, and enabling CSV export for post-market surveillance governance evidence.

nodes.title: Reviewer workflow and change-control surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO covering reviewer approval workflow, clinical impact assessment, evidence engagement gate, change queue prioritisation, and deployment interlock. UNs: UN-F6A0C5BA, UN-ED00ED74, UN-8659DD53, UN-EA93F7B7, UN-785DFCDE. Components: services/api/app/routers approvals + change-queue, services/ui review surface, deployment interlock in CI.

nodes.title: Risk-scored change queue with production deployment interlock
nodes.description: Pending changes SHALL appear in a single queue ordered by configurable risk score and SHALL be blocked from any production pipeline until approved.

nodes.title: Structured approval capture with immutable audit and deploy interlock
nodes.description: Approval actions SHALL require mandatory rationale fields, write append-only audit records, and SHALL bind deployment jobs to the approval identifier.

nodes.title: Integrity-verified deployment package matching approved artifact
nodes.description: Production deployment SHALL only accept packages whose cryptographic hash matches the approved release record, and SHALL reject any package failing verification.

nodes.title: Mandatory clinical impact assessment section before approval
nodes.description: The review workflow SHALL require completion of the structured clinical impact questionnaire and SHALL block approval until all mandatory impact questions are answered.

nodes.title: Active evidence engagement gate before AI recommendation confirmation with urgency-criterion requirement
nodes.description: The system SHALL render the AI recommendation confirm button as disabled until a reviewer has performed the configured minimum active evidence engagement actions, with high-urgency recommendations requiring explicit confirmation of the primary urgency criterion.

nodes.title: Reviewer engagement metrics logging and clinical safety officer monitoring view for automation bias detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL log reviewer engagement metrics (time on evidence, findings reviewed, assertion changes, corrections) per review session, and SHALL provide a clinical safety officer monitoring view with low-engagement flags and configurable thresholds.

nodes.title: Confirmation state reset on reviewer correction with mandatory re-engagement before re-confirmation
nodes.description: The system SHALL reset the AI recommendation confirmation state and require reviewer re-engagement whenever a reviewer edits or removes a confirmed finding, ensuring the updated recommendation is reviewed before final confirmation.

nodes.title: Change queue item context display, sort/filter, reviewer notification, and escalation for overdue items
nodes.description: The system SHALL display full context fields per queue item (change type, customer, summary, date, risk classification), support sort and filter, and send reviewer notifications on submission with configurable-threshold escalation.

nodes.title: Deployment status panel on approved change records visible from review interface
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface deployment status (pending/deployed/rejected) with timestamp and deploying user on each approved change record within the review interface, updated in real time.

nodes.title: Conditional approval condition list with per-condition confirmation tracking and deployment gate enforcement
nodes.description: The system SHALL require conditional approvals to include at least one named condition, track each condition's confirmation state individually, and block deployment until all conditions are confirmed.

nodes.title: Rejection return workflow with mandatory reasons-addressed step and parent-child change linkage
nodes.description: The system SHALL require requestors to document a response to each rejection reason before resubmission is permitted, link resubmissions to their parent rejected change, and deliver rejection notifications promptly.

nodes.title: Change history pattern surfacing and systematic guideline divergence flagging in impact review panel
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface previous changes of the same type with outcomes and incidents, and SHALL flag systematic guideline divergence when a change modifies a guideline-mapped rule, with the flag generated independently of the requestor.

nodes.title: Structured before/after diff rendering for all change types in the review pane
nodes.description: The system SHALL render a structured side-by-side diff of the before and after change state for all change types, generated from the stored artefact and accessible within the review pane.

nodes.title: Pathway intervals, waiting times, benchmark + IMD analytics
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the analytics surface for pathway intervals, national benchmarks and IMD deprivation: `services/analytics_api/app/routers/imd.py`, `_audit_helpers.py`, `dashboards.py`, `services/fhir_api/app/services/benchmark_loader.py`, `scripts/build_ncda_*.py`, `libs/cypher/admin_queries.py`, ODS sync in `services/ods_sync/`.

Gaps (batch-14 theme B): DI-EE4E6477 HITL gate on pathway intervals; national benchmark UI overlays for all dashboards (DI-BA2C8F3E).

nodes.title: Population pathway dashboards with national benchmark overlays
nodes.description: The analytics service SHALL provide dashboards of population pathway metrics with national benchmark series, drill-down filters, and exportable definitions for each figure.

nodes.title: Configurable pathway interval calculation and waiting time target breach detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically calculate pathway interval values for all configured milestone pairs in each episode and SHALL assess each interval against the programme-defined target, flagging breaches with the specific interval, threshold, and overage; all definitions SHALL be stored as runtime-configurable programme data.

nodes.title: HITL gate: pathway interval calculations use only reviewer-accepted milestone data
nodes.description: The system SHALL ensure all pathway interval calculations and breach assessments are performed exclusively on milestone data that has been accepted by a qualified reviewer, and SHALL return a pending status rather than provisional metrics for episodes with any unreviewed milestones.

nodes.title: Multi-level pathway metrics aggregation at organisation, PCN, and ICB with ODS-sourced hierarchy
nodes.description: The system SHALL aggregate pathway interval metrics and breach rates at organisation (ODS), PCN, and ICB levels using a configurable hierarchy sourced from ODS reference data, with RBAC-controlled access to each aggregation tier.

nodes.title: Waiting time target performance panel (FDS 28d, DTT 31d, RTT 62d) with breach highlighting and drill-down
nodes.description: The system SHALL display national waiting time target performance (FDS 28-day, DTT 31-day, RTT 62-day) with breach highlighting and drill-down to episode list within the dashboard, completing within the 3-second load target.

nodes.title: IMD deprivation analysis panel for pathway performance with health equity monitoring support
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a deprivation analysis panel segmenting pathway performance by IMD decile, with consistent filtering and cited data sources, to support health equity monitoring.

nodes.title: Append-only audit emitter and security-event log
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the audit-trail surface: `libs/audit/audit_emitter.py` (FHIR AuditEvent-shaped write-ahead emitter), `libs/audit/security_log.py` (security-relevant events), `libs/audit/kg_verified_writeback.py` (verified writeback provenance), `services/api/app/routers/audit.py` (read API), append-only `:AuditEvent` and `:Change` node discipline in Cypher.

Gaps (batch-15 Theme D): packaged regulator-export endpoint with signed manifest (UN-F8E1F0D0); end-to-end retention lifecycle policy enforcement; Class-A/B/C evidence bundle generator aligned with `design-controls/DC-TM-001`. Backlogged.

nodes.title: Published integrator documentation and auditable API interactions
nodes.description: The system SHALL publish versioned integration documentation and SHALL record sufficient API-level audit metadata for integrators to trace requests, job identifiers, and principal outcomes for inclusion in a downstream technical file.

nodes.title: Exportable tamper-evident review decision ledger
nodes.description: The system SHALL maintain an append-only ledger of review decisions with hash chaining and SHALL export the full ledger with verification instructions for third-party inspection.

nodes.title: LEO Core AI component version identifier included in every API response for downstream traceability
nodes.description: The system SHALL include a LEO Core AI component version identifier in every API response, enabling downstream integrators to link API outputs to a specific software version in their technical files.

nodes.title: API audit log endpoint with per-credential time-bounded query and minimum 10-year retention
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose a time-bounded audit log API endpoint that returns all API calls made by a given product credential, retained for a minimum of 10 years, with access restricted to the credential owner and authorised Mizaic personnel.

nodes.title: Audit trail 10-year retention enforcement with platform version recording and summary report by date range
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a minimum 10-year audit trail retention with a non-reducible configuration floor, record platform version on every event, and provide a summary report API by date range.

nodes.title: Coding resolver vector-skip threshold (services/terminology_api/app/services/coding_resolver.py)
nodes.description: CodingResolver updated with _top_lexical_score() and _vector_skip_score() helpers and a TERMINOLOGY_VECTOR_SKIP_SCORE env knob defaulting to 0.70. Both resolve() and _resolve_single() now include a term in vector_needed unless its top merged lexical score meets or exceeds skip_score. Preserves TERMINOLOGY_ENABLE_VECTOR=false global kill-switch.

nodes.title: Terminology hybrid retrieval skips vector search only when top lexical score >= 0.7
nodes.description: The CodingResolver SHALL run the vector-search branch whenever the top lexical score (exact + fulltext merged) is below a configurable threshold, defaulting to 0.70 (TERMINOLOGY_VECTOR_SKIP_SCORE). The vector branch SHALL be skipped only when the top lexical score meets or exceeds the threshold, OR when TERMINOLOGY_ENABLE_VECTOR=false. This rule SHALL apply to both the batched resolve() path and the single-term _resolve_single() path.

nodes.title: Relation linking subgraph with method-tagged model+LLM merge
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/relation_linking.py` covering ontology-constrained relation extraction (DI-3EA60D5A), typed-tuple persistence with confidence (DI-318B864C), and method disclosure (DI-2D9F5064). Implements a model-first relation predictor, optional LLM fallback, and a merge step that now tags each relation with extraction_method in {model, llm, model+llm}. Runtime policy enforcement via libs/relations/policy.py.

Code improvement delivered 2026-04-17 in the same changeset: _merge_model_and_llm now preserves and propagates extraction_method; _apply_relation_linking writes extraction_method into the persisted relation dict.

Gaps (improvements-backlog batch-05): schema_mapper VALID_RELATION_TYPES is a superset of policy allowlist; no E2E integrity parity check; no blocking F1 gate in canary promotion.

nodes.title: Ontology-constrained clinical relation extraction
nodes.description: Relation linking SHALL emit only edges permitted by SNOMED structural constraints for the selected concepts and SHALL reject invalid combinations with logged reasons.

nodes.title: End-to-end relation link integrity through the full processing pipeline
nodes.description: The system SHALL guarantee that every relation link created at extraction is preserved without modification or silent loss through every subsequent pipeline stage, from extraction through review, training feedback, inference, and audit trail storage; any discrepancy SHALL trigger an alert and halt the affected pipeline.

nodes.title: Relation link persistence data model: typed tuples with confidence and multi-link support
nodes.description: The system SHALL persist relation links as typed, directed graph edges containing relation type, confidence score, extraction model version, timestamp, and assertion context, and SHALL permit multiple outgoing relations from a single source entity to support one-to-many finding-to-qualifier relationships.

nodes.title: Runtime relation linking method disclosure (model prediction vs LLM fallback) to reviewer
nodes.description: The system SHALL record and surface to the reviewer whether each relation link was produced by the NER model prediction or by the LLM fallback mechanism, including the confidence score for model-produced links, so that reviewers can apply appropriate scepticism to low-confidence and fallback relations.

nodes.title: Per-relation-type quality gates and metrics for relation model promotion
nodes.description: The system SHALL produce per-relation-type precision, recall, and F1 metrics for every relation model training run and SHALL enforce a configurable quality gate that blocks promotion of any model that fails the threshold on any supported relation type.

nodes.title: Plain-language interpretation and human-review gate
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-575E8DCB plain-language interpretation. Components: libs/prompts/interpretation_v1.py and libs/llm_client interpretation pipeline (DI-66F1B177, DI-604767B1), services/api/app/services interpretation formatter (DI-A3107424), services/ui interpretation viewer (DI-DA7584D8), reviewer sign-off gate before publish (DI-69C29EEF).

nodes.title: Plain-language interpretation of coded findings for reviewers
nodes.description: For each reviewer-selected coded finding, the system SHALL generate a plain-English interpretation at the configured reading level with linked source codes and explicit uncertainty when evidence is partial.

nodes.title: Human-review gate blocking publication of AI-generated interpretations without reviewer decision
nodes.description: The system SHALL prevent any AI-generated plain-language interpretation from being published, shared, exported, or surfaced to a downstream consumer unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit accept or reject decision against that specific interpretation; the gate SHALL be enforced at the API layer, not only in the UI.

nodes.title: Diagnostic and treatment recommendation exclusion from generated interpretations
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply a post-generation content classification check to every AI-generated interpretation that detects and blocks outputs containing diagnostic conclusions, differential diagnoses, or treatment recommendations before the output is presented to any user or API consumer.

nodes.title: Confidence level displayed alongside each AI-generated interpretation
nodes.description: The system SHALL include a confidence level in every generated plain-language interpretation, derived from the confidence scores of the underlying extracted entities, presented as both a numeric value and a human-readable tier label visible to the reviewer alongside the interpretation text.

nodes.title: Clinical significance framing: interpretation content bounded to structured input facts
nodes.description: The system SHALL verify that every generated interpretation contains only clinical statements that are directly supported by the structured coded findings passed as input, and SHALL reject any interpretation that introduces clinical facts not present in the structured input set.

nodes.title: Per-type review-queue Cypher and role state
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the existing per-type review queues: `libs/cypher/coding_review_queries.py` (CodingReview/REVIEWS_CODING + TrainingLabel linkage), `libs/cypher/surface_form_task_queries.py`, `libs/cypher/role_queries.py` CANONICAL_ROLES + RoleSwitch audit, `libs/auth/role_state.py`.

Gaps (improvements-backlog batch-11): no unified review-queue endpoint presenting all AI proposal types grouped by type to the reviewer's authorised role set (DI-890BE989); router docstrings reference required roles but no Depends() dependency enforces them at the API layer (DI-E83828A9).

nodes.title: RBAC enforcement for all AI output review and finalisation actions
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce role-based access control for all AI output review and finalisation actions, ensuring that no AI-generated entity, episode classification, quality alert, or clinical interpretation can be accepted, edited, or rejected without a user who has an appropriate assigned role performing the action.

nodes.title: Unified review queue for all AI proposal types with reviewer corrections stored as structured training data
nodes.description: The system SHALL present all AI-generated proposals in a unified role-based review queue grouped by type, and SHALL store reviewer corrections as structured training data linked to the original proposal for use in the model improvement cycle.

nodes.title: Tier classifier v2 (libs/coding_engine/tier_classifier.py + post_processing integration)
nodes.description: Tier classifier enhanced with _TierThresholds dataclass and per-semantic-tag _TIER_THRESHOLDS map, effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence), TIER1_EXTRACTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.80, and new demotion rules for assertion_parity_failed and disorder_verdict='gate_failed'. Post-processing stack in libs/pipeline/post_processing.py snapshots the LLM-assigned assertion and applies the parity check after all deterministic layers. Tier-classify subgraph in libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/tier_classify.py passes the new fields to classify_tier().

nodes.title: Assertion parity check between LLM extractor and ConText post-processing
nodes.description: The post-processing stack SHALL compare the LLM extractor's self-rated assertion (snapshotted at the start of post-processing) with the final assertion determined by ConText and situation-lookup layers, and SHALL set an assertion_parity_failed flag on the entity when they differ. Entities with assertion_parity_failed=true SHALL NOT be eligible for tier 1 auto-coding regardless of terminology score.

nodes.title: Per-semantic-tag tier thresholds with extractor-confidence fusion
nodes.description: The tier classifier SHALL apply per-semantic-tag tier-1 and tier-2 score thresholds (e.g. disorder: 0.92/0.70, finding: 0.93/0.70, default: 0.95/0.70) and SHALL compute an effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence). Tier 1 SHALL additionally require extractor_confidence >= 0.80 (TIER1_EXTRACTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR). Entities where assertion_parity_failed or disorder_verdict == GATE_FAILED SHALL be demoted to tier 2 regardless of effective_score.

nodes.title: Multi-label NER schema mapper and post-processing normalisation
nodes.description:
Retrospective DO documenting `libs/ner/schema_mapper.py` (VALID_RELATION_TYPES, stable entity-id hashing that keys on (doc_id, start, end, label) so same-span differing-label entities are both retained) and `libs/pipeline/post_processing.py` normalisation, which together give the runtime + training paths one entity per span-label pair.

Gap (tracked in improvements-backlog batch-04): dedupe does not branch on lookup_term when two same-(start,end,label) entries differ on clinical qualifier; and LLM scope guard does not enforce per-document subset against NER label set.

nodes.title: Multi-type span classification for overlapping SNOMED concepts
nodes.description: The NER pipeline SHALL emit zero or more SNOMED concept assignments per text span when clinically valid, preserving all non-conflicting semantic types rather than forcing a single winner-take-all label.

nodes.title: LLM semantic tag scope constraint to validated NER model output set
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that the LLM extraction step cannot introduce SNOMED semantic type labels that were not produced by the NER model for the same document; any additional semantic tags SHALL be detected and removed by the post-processing layer before the result is stored or returned.

nodes.title: Inference API response schema: one result per span-label pair for multi-type spans
nodes.description: The system SHALL define and enforce an inference API response schema that returns one entity object per span-label pair, enabling downstream consumers to receive multiple typed results for the same character span without requiring additional queries.

nodes.title: Post-processing preservation of overlapping same-label spans with divergent terminology lookups
nodes.description: The system SHALL preserve overlapping spans that share the same SNOMED semantic type label when their normalised terminology lookup terms differ, treating them as distinct clinical entities rather than duplicates requiring deduplication.

nodes.title: Clinical intelligence decision-support surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for clinician-facing decision support: treatment options, investigation ordering, referrals, recovery markers, clinic list preparation, MDT summary, and investigation thresholds. UNs: UN-1A6F1E0E, UN-F3300833, UN-9206EFF0, UN-2266BDAE, UN-67663AAF, UN-9396A2FA, UN-06FD3F7D. Components: libs/pipeline_graph clinical intelligence subgraphs + services/ui view rendering + informational-only disclaimers.

nodes.title: Present investigation escalation thresholds and comparable cohort trajectories
nodes.description: The system SHALL display guideline-defined investigation escalation thresholds and comparable population trajectories for the active pathway context whenever a user views investigation results for triage or follow-up.

nodes.title: Surface guideline treatment recommendations with comparable outcome summaries
nodes.description: The system SHALL present the active guideline's treatment recommendations for the pathway stage together with comparable-cohort outcome summaries and explicit data limitations in the clinician-facing view.

nodes.title: Post-treatment recovery markers and comparable trajectories
nodes.description: The system SHALL show guideline-defined expected recovery markers and comparable recovery trajectories for similar patients when reviewing post-treatment follow-up.

nodes.title: Clinic list preparation view with pathway status and comparators
nodes.description: The clinic preparation view SHALL list outstanding pathway actions, current stage versus targets, and anonymised comparators for similar patients at the same stage.

nodes.title: Referral triage view with eligibility rules and comparable outcomes
nodes.description: The referral workspace SHALL display pathway eligibility criteria and comparable anonymised outcomes for similar referrals at decision time.

nodes.title: MDT case summary template with pathway checklist and comparators
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate an MDT summary covering mandatory pathway checklist items and comparable prior MDT decisions for similar cases, with explicit gaps where data are missing.

nodes.title: Investigation ordering assistance with guideline norms and comparators
nodes.description: The ordering view SHALL show guideline-recommended investigations for the pathway stage and anonymised ordering frequencies for comparable patients.

nodes.title: Alert fatigue suppression for normal-range investigation results with configurable programme-level thresholds
nodes.description: The system SHALL suppress alert-level notifications for investigation results within the configured normal range for the patient's current pathway stage, with thresholds stored as programme-level configuration.

nodes.title: Persistent informational-only disclaimer on all clinician-facing clinical intelligence output panels
nodes.description: The system SHALL render a persistent 'informational signposting only' disclaimer on every clinician-facing clinical intelligence output panel, drawn from configurable text.

nodes.title: Neutral unranked treatment option display with cohort disclosure and lay-readable consultation mode
nodes.description: The system SHALL display treatment options in a neutral, unranked presentation with cohort match criteria and data source disclosed, and SHALL provide a lay-readable rendering mode for use during patient-facing consultations.

nodes.title: Trajectory deviation prompts require structured documented clinician response, not dismissal
nodes.description: The system SHALL require documented clinician acknowledgement (structured response action) for trajectory deviation prompts, not just dismissal, and SHALL store the response in the audit trail.

nodes.title: AI-generated labelling on clinician pre-reads with one-click guideline source access and automated pre-session availability
nodes.description: The system SHALL label all AI-generated content in clinician pre-reads with visible AI-generated indicators, provide one-click guideline source access, and populate pre-reads automatically before the clinic preparation window.

nodes.title: Triage view: visually distinct labelled panels, cohort filter by age/symptom/source, single-view completion
nodes.description: The system SHALL visually distinguish guideline and cohort panels with informational labelling, support cohort filtering by age band, presenting symptom, and referral source, and enable triage completion within the single view.

nodes.title: MDT summary AI-content labelling, pre-submission editability, and edit delta record preserving AI original
nodes.description: The system SHALL label all AI-generated MDT summary content with visible badges, allow full pre-submission editing of all fields, and store clinician edits as a separate delta record preserving both the original AI-generated and final clinician-reviewed text.

nodes.title: Non-blocking investigation deviation acknowledgement with logged rationale and visible cohort match criteria
nodes.description: The system SHALL require non-blocking acknowledgement with a reason when a clinician deviates from guideline-recommended investigations, log the deviation, and display the cohort match criteria used for the comparator panel.

nodes.title: Relation reviewer UI with policy-aware triplets
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the gold-dataset relation reviewer UI that renders source -> type -> target triplets with a LinkOff warning when no relation is set. Surfaces accept/reject/undo from a single card.

Gap (DI-3035F221 partial): per-pair SNOMED structural policy explanation is not rendered inline on the reviewer card; extraction_method chip not yet shown. Tracked in improvements-backlog batch-05.

nodes.title: Reviewer interface for relation assessment with SNOMED structural policy guidance
nodes.description: The system SHALL present each proposed relation link to the reviewer alongside the SNOMED structural policy recommendation for that concept pair, and SHALL support accept, reject, and undo actions from a single review card without requiring additional navigation.

nodes.title: Coding correction review and dependency display surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-7D740697 covering correction review + SNOMED relation display. Components: services/ui/src/components/operations/CodingReviewCasesModal.tsx (DI-1B8AC856, DI-13F340B9), services/terminology_api hierarchy lookup (DI-26CBDB16, DI-04105500), services/api/app/routers/training.py ask-leo endpoints (DI-22F4E3CE), services/ui AssertionChip + review queue (DI-4221A226).

nodes.title: Coding correction review with dependency and terminology validation
nodes.description: The reviewer workflow SHALL show downstream dependents of a proposed code change and SHALL run terminology validation rules before approval is permitted.

nodes.title: Large-scale coding correction mandatory secondary review threshold gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a mandatory secondary reviewer approval for any coding correction that affects a number of historical patient records at or above a configurable programme-level threshold, and SHALL block the approval of such corrections unless two distinct credentialed reviewers have each recorded a decision.

nodes.title: Terminology currency validation for proposed replacement codes in coding corrections
nodes.description: The system SHALL validate that any proposed replacement code in a coding correction request is present and active in the current release of the relevant controlled terminology (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, or OPCS) at the time of both submission and approval; deprecated codes SHALL be rejected with an explicit error that includes the terminology version consulted.

nodes.title: Coding correction request structured display schema (original, replacement, concept, rationale)
nodes.description: The system SHALL capture and display a structured coding correction request that includes the original code and display term, the proposed replacement code and display term, the clinical concept both codes are intended to represent, and the requester's rationale; all fields are mandatory.

nodes.title: Historical code frequency display on coding correction review page
nodes.description: The system SHALL display the historical frequency of the original code in the active patient dataset on the coding correction review page, showing counts for the last 12 months and the full historical period, to enable the reviewer to assess the potential scope of impact.

nodes.title: NLP surface form dependency display in coding correction review
nodes.description: The system SHALL display on the coding correction review page all NLP surface form strings currently mapped to the original code, including their match type and historical frequency, so the reviewer can identify surface form mapping dependencies that would need to be updated if the correction is approved.

nodes.title: Authoritative source monitoring and release management
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for NICE/ODS/SNOMED CT/ICD-10/OPCS synchronisation, diff reports, source change detection and currency dashboard. UNs: UN-A412610D, UN-E6195868, UN-12EEF12D, UN-87CB1498, UN-4AEB2F29, UN-06FDC315, UN-319F33F0. Components: libs/knowledge_sync, services/knowledge_api release endpoints, services/ui currency dashboard. Code-gaps: NICE TA/QS SLA timers and guideline monitoring registry partially implemented.

nodes.title: ICD-10 and OPCS release impact analysis with gated activation
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute structured diffs between each NHS Digital ICD-10 and OPCS release and active LEO mappings, block activation until mandatory sign-off records exist for secondary-uses mappings, and retain an auditable change history.

nodes.title: SNOMED CT release diff with blocking resolution workflow
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute diffs for each SNOMED CT import against the active dictionary and SHALL block activation until every blocking item has a disposition record.

nodes.title: Knowledge base currency dashboard with exportable surveillance evidence
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a consolidated dashboard listing last verification, next review due date, and status for every active guideline and reference dataset, and SHALL export the same snapshot for post-market surveillance records.

nodes.title: Authoritative source change detection with routed alerts
nodes.description: The system SHALL monitor configured authoritative sources for updates, match them to affected pathways, and create routed alerts with direct links to source artefacts.

nodes.title: NICE TA and QS impact tracking with SLA timers
nodes.description: The content governance tool SHALL record each new or updated Technology Appraisal and Quality Standard, assess LEO impact, and track time-bound implementation tasks to closure.

nodes.title: Weekly ODS synchronisation with blocking resolutions for breaking changes
nodes.description: The reference data service SHALL import ODS deltas weekly, flag breaking changes, and block downstream use of retired organisation codes until each is resolved or remapped.

nodes.title: Content currency gate: marking as current requires linked verification event; automatic overdue transition by type-specific interval
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that content components can only be marked as current via a recorded verification event linked to an authoritative source reference, and SHALL automatically transition components to 'overdue' when their type-specific review interval is exceeded.

nodes.title: Active SNOMED CT version endpoint for downstream integrator technical file documentation
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose the active SNOMED CT UK Edition version via a dedicated API endpoint for use in downstream integrators' technical files, updated automatically when a new release is activated.

nodes.title: Guideline monitoring registry under clinical change control with full alert context and escalation
nodes.description: The system SHALL subject the guideline monitoring registry to the same change control and version control as clinical content, and SHALL include full alert context (source, date, scope, link) with automatic escalation for unacknowledged alerts.

nodes.title: NICE structured assessment prompt with mandatory obligation detection and 'not applicable' rationale recording
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate structured NICE assessment prompts covering all four mandatory fields, automatically create time-bound change requests for mandatory obligations, and allow 'not applicable' recording with documented rationale without triggering a change request.

nodes.title: Per-pathway NICE alignment status report with exportable post-market surveillance output
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a per-pathway NICE alignment status report showing last reviewed date, applicable publications, and open implementation obligations, filterable and exportable for post-market surveillance use.

nodes.title: ODS change report four-type classification (new, retired, successor, merger/split) with effective dates
nodes.description: The system SHALL classify ODS changes in the weekly sync report into four distinct types (new, retired, successor assignment, merger/split), each with effective date and successor code, to enable targeted resolution by type.

nodes.title: Pre-application customer notification for attribution-affecting ODS changes and historical mapping retention
nodes.description: The system SHALL notify affected customers before applying ODS changes that affect patient pathway attribution, and SHALL maintain an immutable historical ODS mapping record enabling accurate retrospective pathway attribution queries.

nodes.title: NICE ingest: scheduled automated ingestion via NICE API into structured knowledge graph nodes
nodes.description: The system SHALL ingest NICE publications from the NICE API on a configurable automated schedule, storing each as a structured knowledge graph node with publication type, guideline number, version, publication date, pathway tags, and source URL, alerting the content manager on ingestion failure.

nodes.title: NICE catalogue: domain taxonomy classification and three-state coverage status against active pathway rules
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically classify each ingested NICE publication against the active domain taxonomy and assign a coverage status of rule-covered, change-request-open, or no-coverage, updating this status automatically as linked pathway rules and change requests are created or resolved.

nodes.title: Research workspace and cohort builder surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-47B82B96 research workspace. Components: services/analytics_api/app/services cohort builder (DI-DD67ACFF, DI-93162C3C), services/ui research workspace view (DI-9DCBC4BA), de-identification export pipeline (DI-58988BF2). Code-gap: full cohort builder UI planned but incomplete.

nodes.title: Guided population research workspace with plain-English scoping
nodes.description: The research workspace SHALL guide users through mission selection and scoped questions, then run only approved graph analytics templates and return plain-English summaries with query provenance.

nodes.title: Research workspace results data coverage indicator with low-coverage advisory
nodes.description: The system SHALL include a data coverage indicator on every research workspace result showing population completeness, with a prominent advisory note when coverage falls below 60%.

nodes.title: Persona lens control reframing workspace language for different user roles without changing analysis
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a persona lens control on the research workspace that reframes mission titles, scoping questions, and result language for different user roles without altering the underlying analysis or data.

nodes.title: Research workspace single-action structured export with method metadata and no patient identifiers
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a single-action structured file export from the research workspace results panel, including result data, scoping parameters, analysis method identifier, and coverage indicator, with no patient identifiers in the export.

nodes.title: SBAR generation subgraph
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/sbar.py` and associated state in `libs/pipeline_graph/state.py` that generates SBAR summaries from coded encounters and pathway state. Provenance writer in `libs/cypher/documents_queries.py` supplies link-back capability.

Gaps (batch-13 theme A): DI-8804DA01 finalisation gate with AI-original/edit delta is not implemented; DI-740BE510 per-statement provenance regression test missing.

nodes.title: SBAR: AI-generated structured summary from coded encounters, pathway stage, and safety netting alerts
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate an SBAR-structured clinical summary for a patient by synthesising their coded encounters, current pathway stage, and any outstanding safety netting alerts, using the active LLM prompt for summary generation and labelling all content as AI-generated.

nodes.title: SBAR: mandatory human review gate before finalisation with AI-original/edit delta record
