nodes.description: The system SHALL require a clinician review step before an SBAR summary is marked as finalised, and SHALL record any edits made during review as a structured delta preserving the original AI-generated text alongside the edited text, with the editor identity and timestamp.

nodes.title: SBAR: source encounter and coded entity provenance links on every clinical statement
nodes.description: The system SHALL link each clinical statement in a generated SBAR section to the source encounter node and coded entity from which it was derived, surfacing these provenance links in the SBAR user interface and preserving them in the exported record.

nodes.title: NER + SNOMED coding surface with assertion handling
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-0374FE26 SNOMED coding core. Components: libs/ner NER pipeline (DI-1795254D, DI-4247C7E5), libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs SNOMED linker and assertion layer (DI-31126C6C, DI-375C7EB1), libs/pipeline/post_processing.py 9-layer post-processing, services/coding_worker runtime pipeline. Code-gap flagged in improvements-backlog: gold F1 evaluator for DI-12015DBC and per-semantic-tag threshold drift monitoring for DI-88C8BBCD.

nodes.title: FHIR R4 compliant API for all patient record ingestion and audit result export
nodes.description: The system SHALL retrieve all patient clinical records exclusively via a FHIR R4 compliant API, and SHALL export audit results and pipeline outputs as FHIR resources, so that all patient data exchange uses a standards-based interface that does not depend on proprietary source system integrations.

nodes.title: HITL gate: SNOMED coding proposals require individual reviewer decision before entering final audit data
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that no AI-generated SNOMED coding proposal can be written to the final audit dataset, exported, or consumed by any downstream product unless a qualified reviewer has individually accepted or rejected that proposal; this gate SHALL be enforced at the API layer and SHALL be immutably logged.

nodes.title: NER-to-SNOMED entity extraction with confidence score and full provenance metadata
nodes.description: The system SHALL extract clinical entities from free text using a NER model and link each entity to a SNOMED CT concept with a confidence score, character span, semantic type, and extraction model version; entities below the confidence threshold SHALL be explicitly routed for disambiguation rather than silently dropped.

nodes.title: Assertion context label and evidence display on SNOMED coding review card
nodes.description: The system SHALL display the assertion context label (present, negated, historical, family history, suspected), assertion confidence score, and triggering text window for each SNOMED coding proposal on the reviewer's coding card.

nodes.title: SNOMED coding accuracy quality gate: minimum F1 0.85 on gold-standard dataset
nodes.description: The system SHALL measure NER-to-SNOMED coding accuracy as F1 on a frozen gold-standard dataset at each model release and SHALL enforce a minimum F1 quality gate of 0.85 that blocks production promotion of any coding model that fails this threshold.

nodes.title: LLM fallback method labelling and threshold configuration for NER coding proposals
nodes.description: The system SHALL label every NER-extracted entity with a machine-readable extraction method field (ner_primary, ner_with_llm_fallback, llm_only) and SHALL surface this label prominently on the reviewer's coding card; the LLM fallback threshold SHALL be configurable per programme.

nodes.title: Episode builder subgraph with classification + DQ
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the episode construction + classification surface: `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/episode.py`, prompts in `libs/prompts/episode_builder_v1.py` and `episode_builder_output_schema.py`, DQ checks in `libs/dq/episodes.py`, tests in `tests/test_episode_builder.py`.

Gaps (batch-14 theme A): BD696225 human-review gate before audit reporting; 736B698B 85% F1 accuracy gate; A0579B64 reporting block on unresolved flags; deterministic construction invariant (FF9C74E2).

nodes.title: Deterministic episode construction from related encounters
nodes.description: The episode builder SHALL group encounters into episodes using the published grouping rules and SHALL attach pathway milestone states to each episode for review.

nodes.title: Human-review gate blocking audit reporting use of unreviewed episode classifications
nodes.description: The system SHALL prevent any episode classification from being included in an audit report or exported for downstream use unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit decision on that episode; the enforcement SHALL occur at the data query layer and SHALL be logged.

nodes.title: Episode classification status schema (confirmed, excluded, inconclusive)
nodes.description: The system SHALL assign each constructed episode a classification status of confirmed, excluded, or inconclusive based on the programme-defined classification rules, and SHALL display this status with a plain-language explanation to the reviewer.

nodes.title: Episode timeline generation with pathway gap highlighting
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate a timeline view for every constructed episode, showing each constituent encounter as a dated node with its associated pathway milestone and coded entities, with pathway sequence gaps visually highlighted.

nodes.title: Episode classification method disclosure (rule-based vs LLM fallback) to reviewer
nodes.description: The system SHALL record for every episode classification whether the decision was produced by the rule-based primary classifier or the LLM fallback, and SHALL surface this information to the reviewer on the episode card so they can calibrate their review effort accordingly.

nodes.title: Episode classification accuracy gate: minimum 85% F1 against expert consensus
nodes.description: The system SHALL measure episode classification accuracy as F1 against expert consensus on a frozen held-out test set of at least 500 episodes, and SHALL enforce an 85% minimum F1 quality gate that blocks production promotion of any episode classifier model that fails this threshold.

nodes.title: Episode temporal quality checks: duration outliers, missing milestones, and sequence anomaly detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL detect and flag episode duration outliers, missing mandatory milestones, and temporal anomalies in milestone event sequences against configurable programme-level thresholds.

nodes.title: Low-confidence entity flagging and intra-episode coding contradiction detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface low-confidence NLP entity classifications and coding contradictions within each episode as quality flags, visible before the episode is used in any reporting or downstream product.

nodes.title: Episode quality gate: flagged episodes blocked from reporting until flags are resolved
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a quality gate that prevents any episode with unresolved quality flags from being included in a reporting dataset or exported until a reviewer has explicitly resolved each flag, with all resolutions immutably audit-logged.

nodes.title: Consensus runner v2 (libs/llm_client/consensus.py)
nodes.description: Rewritten consensus runner with two honest execution modes. Default single-model path issues one AWS Bedrock call with a strict-reminder parse-retry. Opt-in dual-model path (CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) runs AWS small + Azure small in parallel with AWS big arbitration on disagreement or single-provider failure. Fail-closed when all providers fail. Docstring updated to reflect actual behaviour. Consumed by disorder verifier and coding-verifier call sites without caller-side changes.

nodes.title: Configurable single-vs-dual-model LLM consensus runner
nodes.description: The consensus runner used by the disorder gate and coding-verifier steps SHALL support two modes: (1) single-model (default) - one AWS Bedrock call at the configured tier with a strict-reminder parse-retry on parse failure; (2) dual-model (opt-in via CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) - AWS small-tier and Azure small-tier judges run in parallel, an AWS big-tier arbitrator resolves disagreement or single-provider failure. The runner SHALL fail-closed by returning the caller-supplied fail_verdict when all providers fail.

nodes.title: SpanResolver utility (libs/ner/span_resolver.py)
nodes.description: New shared utility class SpanResolver that resolves absolute character (start, end) offsets for LLM-extracted terms within an encounter. Uses sentence-level and encounter-wide cursors to disambiguate repeated mentions. Consumed by both services/coding_worker/app/pipeline/llm_extractor.py and libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/_extractor.py so both LLM extractor code paths produce accurate spans.

nodes.title: Absolute character-offset resolver for LLM-extracted entities
nodes.description: The extraction pipeline SHALL resolve absolute character offsets (span_start, span_end) for every LLM-extracted entity against the original encounter text, honouring sentence boundaries and repeated mentions, so that every extracted entity has immutable provenance back to its source phrase.

nodes.title: Label-verification and training-export lossless writer
nodes.description:
Retrospective DO documenting `services/api/app/services/label_verifier.py::_process_label` and `libs/ner/training_label_writer.py` which together process and export one record per span-label pair through the label-verification queue to the training JSONL export.

Gap (tracked in improvements-backlog batch-04 / DI-EE80C271 + DI-6EFD68D0): no count-in == count-out invariant is currently enforced so silent collapse of multi-label span pairs would not be detected by existing tests.

nodes.title: Lossless multi-label span export to model training format
nodes.description: The system SHALL export gold label records containing multi-label spans as one training record per span-label pair, preserving character offsets, entity text, and label independently for each type assignment, so that no label is lost during the transition from annotation to model training.

nodes.title: Label verification step multi-label annotation fidelity
nodes.description: The system SHALL ensure that the label verification step reads, displays, and writes back all SNOMED type labels for every span-label pair in a multi-label annotation without collapsing or dropping any label; any reduction in the label count between input and output is treated as a pipeline failure.

nodes.title: Rule-based encounter pre-classification with ClassificationResult persistence
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `libs/classifiers/encounter_classifier.py` and `libs/classifiers/encounter_textcat.py`: deterministic phrase + regex classification into admin_only / document_transfer / clinical. Encounter text is never sent to an LLM (mitigates prompt injection threat NER-T-001). Persists `ClassificationResult` with content_type, domains, encounter_purpose, key_clinical_signals, expected_semantic_tags, clinical_significance, and consensus metadata.

Gaps (improvements-backlog batch-12, DI-8CE01B3E partial + DI-0ADE6A8E partial): no management UI for keyword triggers/programme assignment/confidence threshold; no test-pack gate before rule activation; no explicit misclassification-as-training-example flag; no model-registry hook for classification model versioning.

nodes.title: Encounter classification: managed rules with per-encounter decision persistence and test-pass gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a management interface for encounter classification rules covering keyword triggers, programme assignment, confidence threshold, and fallback behaviour, persisting every classification decision with encounter ID, matched rule, confidence score, and model version, and requiring a test pass before any rule change is activated.

nodes.title: Encounter classification: misclassification labelling feedback loop and model registry integration
nodes.description: The system SHALL allow misclassified encounters to be flagged as labelled training examples directly from the classification review interface, add them to the training corpus, and manage the classification model version through the model registry with the same canary promotion workflow applied to the NER model.

nodes.title: Patient shortlisting and recall surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-B70ACD96 patient shortlisting. Components: services/analytics_api shortlisting service (DI-143F69EB, DI-4746A178), recall evaluation (DI-10BB41E9), shortlist export + audit (DI-1501326A).

nodes.title: Multi-mode encounter shortlisting: keyword, full-text, and vector similarity search with configurable fusion
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply keyword matching, BM25 full-text search, and vector similarity search in parallel across programme-defined clinical domains when shortlisting patient encounters for audit review, with modality fusion weights configurable per programme.

nodes.title: Ranked patient shortlist with fused relevance score and supporting evidence spans
nodes.description: The system SHALL return patient shortlists as ranked results with a fused relevance score, supporting evidence spans, and programme coverage estimate for each candidate, displayed to the reviewer on the shortlisting results screen.

nodes.title: Shortlisting recall quality gate: minimum 95% recall on gold-standard labelled dataset
nodes.description: The system SHALL measure shortlisting recall against a gold-standard labelled dataset at each model release and SHALL enforce a minimum recall quality gate of 0.95 that blocks production promotion of any shortlisting model that fails this threshold.

nodes.title: Programme inclusion criteria stored as versioned configuration applied without code deployment
nodes.description: The system SHALL store patient inclusion criteria for each audit programme as versioned configuration data, applied consistently at each pipeline run without requiring code changes, with full version history retained.

nodes.title: Audit-quality API and drift analytics surface
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `services/api/app/routers/audit_quality.py`, `services/analytics_api/app/routers/audit.py`, `_audit_sections.py`, and `dashboards.py` providing audit/drift metrics endpoints plus the analytics UI surface.

Gaps (batch-13 themes D + E + H): mandatory acknowledgement gate, programme-level kill switch, overcoded-encounter urgent review SLA, 30-cycle dashboard with threshold reference, and root-cause labelling with 2-year immutable history are either missing or partial.

nodes.title: Continuous coding quality metrics with regression alerting
nodes.description: The operations service SHALL compute rolling coding quality metrics on scheduled samples and SHALL raise alerts when any metric crosses configured regression thresholds.

nodes.title: Prominent data completeness and reliability indicators on clinician outputs
nodes.description: Every clinician-facing AI-assisted view SHALL display completeness fraction, reliability tier, and last refresh time for the underlying data before any primary action is enabled.

nodes.title: Cohort metadata disclosure in clinician-facing outputs
nodes.description: The system SHALL include cohort size, record date range, and cohort refresh date in every clinician-facing output that is derived from a matched patient cohort; these metadata fields SHALL be displayed adjacently to the output they describe.

nodes.title: Plain-language coverage indicator explanation reachable in one action
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a plain-language explanation of each coverage indicator, reachable within one user action from the indicator itself, that describes what the coverage fraction represents, how it is calculated, and what the impact of a low score is for the output it accompanies.

nodes.title: Quality regression alert escalation with automatic pipeline pause on unacknowledged threshold breach
nodes.description: The system SHALL implement a multi-stage alert escalation sequence for coding quality regressions that routes unacknowledged alerts to escalating recipients and eventually sets a pipeline pause flag that prevents new processing batches until an administrator clears it.

nodes.title: Overcoded encounter urgent review queue with SLA and escalation
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface overcoded encounters detected by the quality monitoring cycle into a dedicated urgent review queue, with SLA timestamps and escalation notifications for unacknowledged items.

nodes.title: Per-programme AI processing kill switch activatable without code deployment
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a per-programme kill switch that, when activated, halts all new AI processing runs for that programme without requiring a code deployment, with activation and clearance immutably audit-logged.

nodes.title: Coding quality metrics trend dashboard with 30-cycle history and threshold reference lines
nodes.description: The system SHALL display a quality metrics trend dashboard showing time-series charts of coding quality metrics across monitoring cycles, with configurable threshold reference lines and data point drill-down.

nodes.title: Audit quality loops: per-entity-type coding frequency drift detection with configurable threshold
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute the coding frequency distribution per entity type per programme at each audit period boundary, compare consecutive period distributions, and generate an alert when the delta for any entity type exceeds the configurable drift threshold.

nodes.title: Audit quality loops: root cause labelling of drift alerts with 2-year immutable alert history
nodes.description: The system SHALL label each drift alert with a root cause category of model-change-correlated, config-change-correlated, or unexplained, based on whether a model version or pipeline config change was recorded within the comparison window, and SHALL retain alert history immutably for a minimum of 2 years.

nodes.title: LLM extractor v2 (prompt + ExtractedTerm/ExtractionItem parser)
nodes.description: Updated extraction prompt (libs/prompts/extraction_v1.py) with new CLINICAL QUALIFIER PRESERVATION, ASSERTION, and CONFIDENCE sections. Updated parsers in services/coding_worker/app/pipeline/llm_extractor.py and libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/_extractor.py to parse, normalise, and clamp assertion and confidence, resolve absolute spans via SpanResolver, and propagate the new fields onto ExtractedTerm and ExtractionItem records. Added _normalise_assertion and _normalise_confidence helpers.

nodes.title: LLM extractor emits self-rated assertion and confidence per entity
nodes.description: The LLM extractor SHALL emit a self-rated assertion label (present | absent | uncertain | historical | family_history | conditional | hypothetical) and a self-rated confidence score in [0.0, 1.0] for every extracted entity. Values SHALL be parsed, normalised, and clamped, and SHALL be written onto each ExtractedTerm / ExtractionItem for use by downstream tiering and parity checks.

nodes.title: Clinical qualifier preservation in LLM extraction for SNOMED specificity
nodes.description: The LLM extraction prompt (extraction_v1) SHALL instruct the model to preserve clinical qualifiers - laterality, severity, acuity, episodicity, morphology, anatomical site, and temporal qualifiers - in the extracted term text and in the lookup_term field used for SNOMED terminology retrieval. Qualifiers SHALL NOT be stripped to a canonical headword when the source narrative contains them.

nodes.title: Guideline conformance evaluator and rule extraction
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the guideline evaluator and rule-extraction surface: `services/terminology_api/app/services/guideline_evaluator.py`, `services/terminology_api/app/routers/guidelines.py`, `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/guidance_rule_extraction_v2_impl.py`, tests in `services/terminology_api/tests/test_guideline_evaluator.py`.

Gaps (batch-14 theme C): p95 <= 5s performance test (DI-5E25E872); human-review gate for guideline alerts (DI-7913344A); F94EB13F reviewer queue with bidirectional link.

nodes.title: Automated guideline conformance evaluation on coded encounters
nodes.description: The quality engine SHALL evaluate each coded encounter against the active programme rule set, emit severity-scored deviation alerts, and route them to the review queue.

nodes.title: Human-review gate blocking downstream actions from unreviewed guideline alerts
nodes.description: The system SHALL block any downstream product action that is triggered by a guideline alert unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit decision against that specific alert; the enforcement SHALL occur at the API layer and SHALL be logged in the immutable audit trail.

nodes.title: Programme-level guideline rule set configuration without code deployment
nodes.description: The system SHALL allow programme administrators to define, version, and activate guideline rule sets through configuration management without requiring code changes or a new software deployment; each programme SHALL maintain an independently versioned active rule set.

nodes.title: Guideline evaluation completion within 5 seconds per patient at p95
nodes.description: The system SHALL complete guideline evaluation for a single patient and make resulting alerts available in the reviewer queue within 5 seconds at p95 latency under nominal and defined peak load conditions.

nodes.title: Guidance rule extraction: AI-generated structured candidates with source section reference and prompt version
nodes.description: The system SHALL accept a guideline document section as input and produce a structured list of candidate pathway rules, each containing condition, action, population scope, evidence grade, and a direct reference to the source guideline section, executed as an async job with the LLM prompt version recorded on each candidate.

nodes.title: Guidance rule review queue: per-candidate mandatory decision with bidirectional provenance links on promotion
nodes.description: The system SHALL present extracted candidate rules in a review queue requiring a per-candidate decision of accept, reject, or edit with mandatory rationale, blocking promotion until all candidates have a decision, and SHALL create bidirectional links from promoted rules to their source guideline entry and any superseded rules.

nodes.title: Operations teams need automated detection of longitudinal drift in coding patterns with root cause labelling and escalating alerts
nodes.description: As an operations team member, I need automated detection of longitudinal drift in audit coding patterns so that systematic model degradation or clinical practice changes are identified and escalated before they corrupt trend reporting.

nodes.title: Clinical informaticians need a guided research workspace to investigate populations and analyse pathway bottlenecks without data science skills
nodes.description: As a clinical informatician, audit team lead, or pathway coordinator, I need a guided research workspace where I can investigate patient populations, discover cohorts, and analyse pathway bottlenecks by selecting from plain-English mission cards and answering a small number of scoping questions, so that I can conduct meaningful population-level analysis without needing data science skills or knowledge of the underlying graph algorithms.

nodes.title: Technical administrators need a unified Intelligence Console showing the AI learning loop status and next best action
nodes.description: As a clinical informatician or technical administrator responsible for the AI learning loop, I need a unified Intelligence Console that shows the health and status of every stage of the model improvement cycle in one view, with contextual guidance on the next best action, so that the loop is visible, actionable, and self-guiding without requiring expert knowledge of each individual admin subsystem.

nodes.title: Data protection leads need patient identifiers automatically removed from clinical text before transmission to external AI services
nodes.description: As a data protection officer or information governance lead responsible for patient data transmitted to external AI services, I need the system to automatically strip or replace all direct patient identifiers from clinical free text before it is sent to any external LLM API, so that personal health data is not transmitted to a third-party processor beyond what is strictly necessary for the clinical purpose.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need a canary rollout mechanism for new NER model versions with automatic halt on regression
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer, I need a controlled canary rollout mechanism for new NER model versions, so that regressions are detected against live traffic before a model version is fully promoted and the previous version can be automatically reinstated on failure.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need active learning prioritisation, per-entity F1 metrics, golden evaluation set, and warm-start training
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer managing the clinical NER model improvement cycle, I need active learning prioritisation to surface the most informative unlabelled examples first, per-entity F1 metrics from training runs, a frozen golden evaluation set with a blocking quality gate, and warm-start capability from a previously promoted model, so that each training cycle delivers the maximum improvement with the minimum labelling effort.

nodes.title: Operations teams need a real-time dashboard showing pipeline throughput, queue status, and data quality indicators across all active programmes
nodes.description: As an operations team member, I need a real-time operational dashboard showing pipeline throughput, episode build status, encounter processing queues, and DQ indicators across all active programmes, so that failures and quality regressions are detected and actioned before they affect audit outputs.

nodes.title: Audit team leads need completed episodes automatically validated for quality issues before reporting
nodes.description: As an audit team lead, I need completed clinical episodes to be automatically validated for quality issues — duration outliers, missing milestones, temporal anomalies, low-confidence codings, and coding contradictions — so that data quality problems are surfaced and resolved before episodes are used in audit reporting or clinical decisions.

nodes.title: Clinical teams need to define and manage patient cohorts by clinical and demographic criteria for audit, research, and benchmarking
nodes.description: As a quality improvement lead, I need to define and manage named patient cohorts using clinical and demographic inclusion/exclusion criteria, so that audit programmes, research missions, and benchmark comparisons can be scoped to the right population consistently and repeatably.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer needs a structured change queue with risk-prioritised triage so nothing unapproved reaches a live patient pipeline
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer, I need a structured queue of pending changes with sufficient context to prioritise review workload, so that high-risk changes are assessed before lower-risk ones and nothing awaiting approval silently affects a live pipeline.

nodes.title: Clinicians need abnormal investigation results and clinical red flags automatically surfaced with a tracked follow-up worklist
nodes.description: As a clinician, I need abnormal investigation results and clinical red flags to be automatically identified and surfaced with a tracked follow-up worklist, so that actionable findings are not missed between consultations.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer recording a decision needs a structured approval workflow with mandatory rationale, immutable audit record, and hard deployment gate
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer recording a decision, I need to capture a structured, auditable outcome with documented rationale, so that the decision is traceable in the technical file and can withstand post-market surveillance scrutiny.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need the NER model to classify the same text span under multiple SNOMED semantic types simultaneously
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer building a clinical entity recognition model, I need the NER pipeline to support classification of the same text span under multiple SNOMED semantic types simultaneously, so that a clinical entity that is both a disorder and a finding — or both a procedure and an observable — is correctly represented without forcing a single label that loses clinical meaning.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author managing ODS reference data needs automated weekly synchronisation with mandatory resolution of retired codes before they affect routing or pathway attribution
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author maintaining organisational reference data, I need to identify and resolve ODS changes — trust mergers, PCN reorganisations, site closures, and code retirements — before they cause failures in routing logic, reporting hierarchies, or patient pathway attribution.

nodes.title: Developer beginning integration needs a complete, versioned API specification available before writing any code
nodes.description: As a developer beginning integration with LEO Core AI, I need a complete, accurate, and versioned API specification available before writing any code, so I can assess integration effort and design my product architecture correctly from the start.

nodes.title: Clinician preparing a case for MDT needs a structured summary aligned to pathway requirements and comparable MDT decisions
nodes.description: As a clinician preparing a patient for MDT discussion, I need a structured case summary that reflects the pathway requirements for MDT presentation and includes context from how similar cases were discussed and decided, because manual compilation of MDT summaries from multiple systems is time-consuming and produces inconsistent outputs that slow MDT efficiency.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer needs assurance that approved changes are deployed without post-approval modification through an integrity-checked deployment gate
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer, I need assurance that an approved change is deployed exactly as reviewed and that any deviation between the reviewed and deployed state is detected before it reaches a live patient pipeline, so that approval cannot be circumvented by post-approval modification.

nodes.title: Clinical content managers need to maintain the ConText assertion rules that determine whether extracted entities are present, absent, or uncertain
nodes.description: As a clinical content manager, I need to maintain the ConText assertion rules that determine whether extracted entities are present, absent, or uncertain, so that assertion accuracy reflects validated clinical linguistic patterns and can be improved without code changes.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need a de-identified labelled training corpus with a protected holdout evaluation set
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer responsible for training and evaluating clinical NER models, I need a de-identified, labelled training corpus with a protected holdout set that is never included in any training export, so that model training and evaluation are performed on clean data without patient privacy risk, and model performance against the holdout set is a reliable indicator of real-world accuracy.

nodes.title: Clinical content managers need to maintain the surface form dictionary mapping free-text expressions to SNOMED concepts
nodes.description: As a clinical content manager, I need to maintain the dictionary of textual surface forms that map free-text expressions to SNOMED concepts, so that NER extraction accuracy reflects local clinical language and improvements are auditable.

nodes.title: Platform administrators need to configure new audit programmes without code changes
nodes.description: As a platform administrator, I need to configure new clinical audit programmes — including clinical domains, milestone definitions, guideline rule sets, quality targets, and pipeline workflows — through an admin interface without requiring a code change or deployment, so that new programmes can be brought live without involving the engineering team for every configuration update.

nodes.title: Developer maintaining a product built on LEO Core AI needs a predictable versioning and deprecation policy to plan upgrade work
nodes.description: As a developer maintaining a product built on LEO Core AI, I need a predictable versioning and deprecation policy, so I can plan upgrade work without being surprised by breaking changes or forced into emergency remediations.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author managing ICD-10 and OPCS alignment needs structured release diffing with separate mandatory sign-off for secondary uses data mappings
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author maintaining diagnostic and procedure coding alignment, I need to assess NHS Digital ICD-10 and OPCS updates against active coding mappings, because changes to procedure codes or diagnostic categories can introduce errors into pathway logic and secondary uses data submissions if not assessed and resolved before activation.

nodes.title: Clinical content managers need a maintainable reference range library covering normal, borderline, and critical thresholds per investigation type
nodes.description: As a clinical content manager, I need a maintainable reference range library covering normal, borderline, and critical thresholds per investigation type, so that safety netting rules are grounded in validated clinical evidence and can be kept current as guidelines change.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need ontology-grounded relation linking to connect extracted findings to body sites, disorders, and procedures
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer developing clinical entity extraction, I need ontology-grounded relation linking so that extracted findings can be safely connected to their body sites, qualifiers, disorders, and procedures in a way that is validated against SNOMED structural rules, so that downstream pathway logic can reason about complete clinical statements rather than isolated coded entities.

nodes.title: Platform administrators need a structured guided onboarding workflow to provision new healthcare organisations safely
nodes.description: As a platform administrator, I need a structured guided onboarding workflow for provisioning a new healthcare organisation so that all configuration, data connection, and access setup steps are completed in the correct order without manual coordination.

nodes.title: Clinical quality reviewers need coded encounters automatically checked against programme guidelines
nodes.description: As a clinical quality reviewer, I need coded encounter data to be automatically evaluated against programme-defined clinical guideline rules, with deviation alerts generated and prioritised by severity, so that guideline non-compliance is surfaced for my attention rather than requiring manual cross-referencing of coded data against guideline criteria.

nodes.title: Clinicians need an AI-generated SBAR clinical summary from the coded record for handover and MDT use
nodes.description: As a clinician preparing a patient handover or MDT submission, I need a structured SBAR (Situation-Background-Assessment-Recommendation) summary generated from the coded record, so that critical context is communicated consistently without manual reconstruction from individual encounter notes.

nodes.title: Clinical reviewers need a structured queue where every AI proposal must be validated before becoming final audit data
nodes.description: As a clinical coder or human reviewer working with AI-generated audit outputs, I need a structured review queue where every AI proposal — coded encounter, episode classification, quality alert, or clinical interpretation — is presented for my validation before it becomes final audit data, so that AI errors are caught before they affect patient records, audit reporting, or downstream clinical decisions.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author tracking NICE output needs structured assessment of Technology Appraisals and Quality Standards with time-bound change requests for mandatory implementation obligations
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author tracking NICE output, I need to assess new and updated Technology Appraisals and Quality Standards for impact on LEO pathway logic, because commissioning obligations and NICE-mandated interventions must be reflected in the system within a timeframe consistent with NHS contractual requirements.

nodes.title: Clinical content managers need AI-assisted extraction of structured pathway decision rules from guideline text with mandatory clinical reviewer approval
nodes.description: As a clinical content manager, I need AI-assisted extraction of structured decision rules from guideline text so that pathway logic is derived from authoritative sources with full provenance, rather than being authored from memory.

nodes.title: Downstream products need LEO Core AI clinical outputs exposed as standard FHIR R4 resources conformant to UK Core profiles
nodes.description: As a developer building a downstream Mizaic product, I need LEO Core AI outputs to be consumable as standard FHIR R4 resources so that integration does not require custom adapters and the system can be included in a downstream IEC 62304 system context document.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author managing SNOMED CT alignment needs automated release diffing and a mandatory resolution gate before each new release is activated
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author managing SNOMED CT alignment, I need to assess and integrate each SNOMED CT release against the active LEO concept dictionary, because coding changes in a new release can silently corrupt pathway logic, cohort definitions, and clinical analytics if not assessed and resolved before activation.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author withdrawing a superseded guideline needs full dependency enumeration and mandatory resolution before deprecation can proceed
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author withdrawing a superseded guideline, I need to ensure that all dependent pathway logic, decision support rules, and user-facing content are identified and resolved before the guideline is removed, because no part of the system should continue to reference a withdrawn clinical standard after deprecation.

nodes.title: Developer building a regulated product on LEO Core AI needs audit documentation and API-level traceability to satisfy their own IEC 62304 and DCB0129 obligations
nodes.description: As a developer building a regulated medical device product on LEO Core AI, I need sufficient documentation and API-level audit support to satisfy my own IEC 62304 and DCB0129 obligations, so that LEO Core AI behaviour can be traced and evidenced within my product's technical file.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer assessing a coding correction needs full dependency mapping and terminology validation before approving a code change
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer assessing a proposed coding correction, I need to verify that the corrected code accurately maps to the intended clinical concept, so that downstream analytics, pathway logic, and reporting are not corrupted by an incorrect or ambiguous code assignment.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need automated AI-assisted auditing of training labels with safe auto-fix and human review routing
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer or clinical AI team member, I need an automated system that audits training label records for quality issues — assertion errors, label inconsistencies, SNOMED coding problems, and value or unit mismatches — and applies safe fixes automatically while routing SNOMED issues to human review, so that label quality is maintained at scale without requiring manual inspection of every record.

nodes.title: Clinical content managers need NICE publications automatically ingested and catalogued with coverage status against active pathway rules
nodes.description: As a clinical content manager, I need the system to ingest, catalogue, and tag NICE publications into a searchable internal library so that guideline-to-rule traceability is maintained and the gap between published guidance and implemented rules is always visible.

nodes.title: Clinician ordering investigations needs guideline recommendations and comparable ordering patterns to reduce unwarranted variation
nodes.description: As a clinician ordering investigations, I need to see what the guideline recommends at this pathway stage and what investigations were ordered for comparable patients, because without this context investigation ordering varies between clinicians in ways that result in both under-investigation and unnecessary testing.

nodes.title: Pathway coordinators need pathway intervals automatically calculated against programme waiting time targets
nodes.description: As a pathway coordinator or clinical lead, I need pathway intervals and duration metrics automatically calculated against programme-defined waiting time targets, so that I can identify breaches and delays across a patient population without manually performing date arithmetic across multiple records.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author needs automated alerting when authoritative guideline sources publish updates relevant to LEO-managed pathways
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author responsible for the currency and integrity of clinical content in LEO Core AI, I need to be alerted when an authoritative guideline source publishes an update relevant to a LEO-managed pathway, because content drift in a regulated medical device is a patient safety risk and the internal guideline library must not silently diverge from the current evidence base between active monitoring cycles.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author needs a structured authoring environment with mandatory source traceability and staged release control for every guideline entry
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author authoring an update to the internal guideline library, I need a structured authoring environment that enforces traceability to the source document and prevents unreviewed content from entering the active library, because every version of every guideline must be evidenced back to its authoritative source in the technical file.

nodes.title: Audit teams need interpretable benchmark comparison charts in audit report outputs
nodes.description: As a clinical audit team member or programme manager reviewing audit report outputs, I need clear interpretable charts that compare my patient population's performance against national benchmarks, so that I can quickly identify where local performance diverges from the national picture without needing to interpret raw data tables.

nodes.title: Knowledge Base Author needs a consolidated currency dashboard showing verified status and next review date for every active content component as exportable post-market surveillance evidence
nodes.description: As a Knowledge Base Author responsible for the overall currency of the clinical knowledge base, I need a consolidated view of the last verified date and next due review for every active guideline, coding dictionary, and reference dataset, because no content component should age beyond its defined review threshold without a documented decision, and consolidated evidence of oversight is required for post-market surveillance.

nodes.title: Developer integrating long-running operations needs a consistent async job pattern with predictable status lifecycle and notification options
nodes.description: As a developer integrating long-running LEO Core AI operations, I need a consistent, documented async job pattern with predictable status lifecycle and webhook or polling options, so I can build resilient product workflows without custom workarounds for each operation type.

nodes.title: Developer implementing authentication needs a standards-compliant auth model with documented token lifecycle and scope definitions
nodes.description: As a developer implementing authentication against LEO Core AI, I need a clear, standards-compliant auth model with documented token lifecycle and scope definitions, so I can implement it consistently across products and satisfy clinical safety and data governance requirements.

nodes.title: AI engineering teams need every coding override categorised by error type for model improvement
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer or clinical AI team member, I need every human override or correction of an AI coding proposal to be recorded with a structured error category — not just that an override occurred, but why — so that model weaknesses can be identified systematically from real reviewer decisions and addressed in the training cycle rather than through anecdote.

nodes.title: Clinical reviewers and auditors need every AI-extracted entity linked to its source text phrase with immutable provenance
nodes.description: As a clinical reviewer, clinical coder, or auditor working with AI-extracted clinical codes, I need every extracted entity to link back to the exact phrase in the source text that generated it, with the extraction method, confidence score, and assertion context visible alongside it, so that I can verify each extraction in seconds without reading the full source document, and so that a complete evidence chain exists for every coded finding.

nodes.title: Operations teams need continuous coding quality monitoring with automated regression alerts
nodes.description: As an operations team member responsible for deployed NLP model quality, I need continuous automated monitoring of coding quality over time with alerts when regressions occur, so that I can act on deteriorating model performance before it affects the quality of patient data and audit outputs.

nodes.title: Clinician reviewing investigation results needs guideline escalation thresholds and comparable result trajectories to avoid missing actionable findings
nodes.description: As a clinician reviewing investigation results, I need to know what result thresholds the guideline defines as escalation triggers and how comparable results affected pathway progression in practice, because without structured signposting actionable results can be missed or misinterpreted, leading to delayed diagnosis and patient harm.

nodes.title: Clinical leads need population-level pathway performance dashboards with national benchmark comparison
nodes.description: As a clinical informatician, quality improvement lead, or pathway coordinator, I need visual dashboards showing population-level pathway metrics, waiting time performance, and national benchmarks, so that I can monitor programme performance, identify breaches, and compare outcomes against national findings without building manual reports.

nodes.title: Clinical coders need free-text encounter narratives automatically coded to SNOMED CT
nodes.description: As a clinical coder reviewing AI outputs, I need free-text clinical narratives to be automatically coded to SNOMED CT with confidence scores, negation detection, and assertion context — present, historical, family history, suspected — so that manual coding time is reduced and AI proposals can be efficiently verified or corrected rather than coded from scratch.

nodes.title: Platform must enforce physical database-level separation of patient data between tenants with automated provisioning and deprovision
nodes.description: As a platform administrator, I need the system to enforce physical separation of patient data between tenants so that a misconfiguration or access error in one tenant cannot expose patient records from another.

nodes.title: Platform administrators need configuration validation and test mode before activating pipeline changes
nodes.description: As a platform administrator setting up or updating a pipeline configuration for a tenant, I need a test mode that runs the complete configured pipeline against a sample input before activation, so that misconfiguration is caught and visible before the configuration processes real patient records.

nodes.title: Any clinician-facing output must surface the completeness and reliability of the underlying data before a decision is made
nodes.description: As a clinician receiving AI-generated informational context, I need to know how complete and reliable the underlying data is before I use it to inform a clinical decision, because incomplete or unrepresentative data presented without disclosure could lead me to draw incorrect conclusions and act in ways that harm the patient.

nodes.title: Developer validating an integration needs a sandbox environment with synthetic clinical data, fault injection, and full production parity
nodes.description: As a developer validating a LEO Core AI integration, I need a sandbox environment that faithfully represents production behaviour with synthetic clinical data, so I can test against realistic scenarios including edge cases and failure conditions without risk to patient data or live systems.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer assessing a guideline update needs to verify source accuracy and implementation safety as independently evidenced decisions
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer assessing a proposed guideline update, I need to verify that the update accurately reflects the source guideline and that the implementation is clinically safe, so that the device continues to support evidence-based care after the update is applied.

nodes.title: Clinical audit teams need patient records automatically shortlisted for programme relevance
nodes.description: As a clinical coder or audit programme manager, I need the system to automatically retrieve and rank patient encounters from FHIR records by relevance to the configured audit programme, so that my review effort is focused on clinically relevant encounters rather than manually filtering thousands of records.

nodes.title: Platform administrators need a data quality engine with configurable rules, per-episode results, and an exportable governance sitrep
nodes.description: As a platform administrator, I need a structured data quality assessment across all processed episodes and encounters with a consolidated sitrep exportable for governance reporting, so that data completeness and coding accuracy issues are detected before they corrupt audit outputs.

nodes.title: Clinician reviewing a patient after treatment needs expected recovery markers and comparable recovery trajectories to identify early signals of non-response or recurrence
nodes.description: As a clinician reviewing a patient following treatment, I need to know what the guideline defines as expected recovery markers and how similar patients' recovery trajectories looked, because without structured context early signals of non-response or recurrence can be missed until the patient re-presents with advanced disease.

nodes.title: Clinician preparing a clinic list needs pathway stage context and comparable patient profiles to prioritise preparation time
nodes.description: As a clinician preparing for a clinic session, I need a per-patient summary of outstanding pathway actions, current stage against guideline timelines, and how patients with a similar profile were managed at the same point, because manual preparation across multiple systems is time-consuming and risks missing clinically important context before the appointment.

nodes.title: NLP engineers need encounter classification rules and model to be manageable and testable via the platform without code changes
nodes.description: As an NLP engineer, I need encounter classification rules and the classification model to be manageable via the platform, so that encounter eligibility decisions for each audit programme are auditable and improvable without code changes.

nodes.title: Developer handling integration failures needs a structured, consistent error response schema with sufficient diagnostic information
nodes.description: As a developer handling failures in a LEO Core AI integration, I need a structured, consistent error response schema with sufficient diagnostic information, so I can implement appropriate error handling without needing to reverse-engineer failure modes through trial and error.

nodes.title: Clinical auditors need related encounters automatically grouped into structured clinical episodes
nodes.description: As a clinical auditor, I need related patient encounters to be automatically grouped into structured clinical episodes linked to pathway milestones, so that end-to-end patient journeys are visible for review and reporting without manual reconstruction from individual encounter records.

nodes.title: Clinical safety officers need the review interface to require active evidence engagement to prevent automation bias
nodes.description: As a clinical safety officer responsible for the human review gate, I need the review interface to be designed so that reviewers must actively engage with the clinical evidence before they can confirm an AI recommendation — not just acknowledge it — so that the human review step provides genuine clinical oversight rather than becoming a rubber stamp that automation bias reduces to a single click.

nodes.title: Clinician discussing treatment options needs guideline recommendations and real-world outcome context to support informed shared decision-making
nodes.description: As a clinician discussing treatment options with a patient, I need to know what the guideline recommends and how patients with a similar profile responded to each option in practice, because supporting an informed shared decision-making conversation currently requires manually locating guideline references and outcome data from multiple sources under time pressure.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer assessing a proposed change needs a systematic clinical impact assessment to make a defensible approval decision
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer assessing a proposed change, I need to understand the potential clinical impact before making an approval decision, so the decision is defensible and traceable to a documented risk assessment rather than subjective judgement.

nodes.title: Clinical reviewers need plain-language AI interpretation of coded audit findings
nodes.description: As a clinical reviewer working through a coded episode or audit alert, I need the system to generate a plain-language interpretation of what the coded data shows clinically, so that I can quickly understand the significance of a finding without needing to interpret raw SNOMED codes and interval calculations myself.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer needs a complete tamper-evident audit trail of all review decisions exportable for regulatory inspection and post-market surveillance
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer, I need a complete, exportable audit trail of all review decisions, so that Mizaic can produce evidence of clinical oversight for regulatory inspection, customer due diligence, and post-market surveillance without manual reconstruction.

nodes.title: Engineering leads need the platform to follow Mizaic standard architecture and engineering design principles consistently across all services
nodes.description: As an engineering lead responsible for the LEO Core AI platform, I need all services to follow Mizaic's standard architecture and engineering design principles consistently — workflow-as-data, configuration-as-data, async fire-and-track, AI models as graph nodes, secrets from Key Vault, and enforced code quality limits — so that any engineer can onboard to any part of the codebase with predictable patterns, and the system remains maintainable and auditable as it grows.

nodes.title: Platform administrators need AI spend tracking and configurable pricing per tenant
nodes.description: As a platform administrator or commercial lead, I need to track AI model spend per tenant, configure a gross margin target, apply time-limited or perpetual discounts per organisation, and see platform operating costs separately from billable tenant spend — all from an admin interface without a code deployment — so that commercial operations can be managed without engineering involvement.

nodes.title: Mizaic clinical reviewer approval process must enforce credential scoping and conflict of interest controls to constitute genuine clinical governance
nodes.description: As a Mizaic clinical reviewer, I need the system to enforce that only appropriately credentialed reviewers can approve changes within their defined clinical scope, so that approval decisions cannot be made by individuals without the relevant clinical authority or with a conflict of interest.

nodes.title: Clinician reviewing a referral needs pathway criteria and comparable referral outcomes to support consistent triage decisions
nodes.description: As a clinician reviewing an incoming referral, I need to see the relevant pathway eligibility criteria and how similar referrals were triaged and managed, because without this context triage decisions rely on individual recall of guidelines and vary between clinicians in ways that affect patient safety.

userNeed.title: Data protection leads need patient identifiers automatically removed from clinical text before transmission to external AI services
userNeed.description: As a data protection officer or information governance lead responsible for patient data transmitted to external AI services, I need the system to automatically strip or replace all direct patient identifiers from clinical free text before it is sent to any external LLM API, so that personal health data is not transmitted to a third-party processor beyond what is strictly necessary for the clinical purpose.

designInputs.title: Reversible de-identification placeholder substitution with in-memory session mapping
designInputs.description: The system SHALL implement reversible placeholder substitution for patient identifiers, replacing each detected identifier with a typed placeholder token and restoring original values from an in-memory session mapping when processing LLM responses.

designInputs.title: Mandatory pre-LLM de-identification safety gate enforced in LLM client wrapper with bypass prevention
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce a mandatory de-identification step as the first transform in every external LLM API call, implemented in the LLM client wrapper so that no caller can bypass it; the step SHALL detect and replace direct patient identifiers before text is transmitted.

designInputs.title: Physical separation of patient data and terminology data into distinct database instances
designInputs.description: The system SHALL store patient clinical data and clinical terminology data in physically separate database instances with separate credentials, with no direct database-level connections between them, so that a compromise or failure of the terminology database cannot expose or corrupt patient data.

designInputs.title: Patient data encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 minimum
designInputs.description: The system SHALL encrypt all patient clinical data at rest using AES-256 or equivalent, and SHALL transmit all patient data over TLS 1.2 or higher, with all encryption keys managed exclusively via Azure Key Vault, so that patient data is protected against interception and unauthorised access at the storage and transport layers.

designInputs.title: Model canary: automatic halt and production rollback on per-entity F1 regression
designInputs.description: The system SHALL automatically halt a canary and reinstate the production model when F1 for any entity type drops below a configurable per-entity threshold, writing the rollback event to the audit trail with the entity type, F1 delta, and timestamp.

designInputs.title: Model canary: configurable traffic split with audit trail tagging of canary runs

designInputs.description: The consensus runner used by the disorder gate and coding-verifier steps SHALL support two modes: (1) single-model (default) - one AWS Bedrock call at the configured tier with a strict-reminder parse-retry on parse failure; (2) dual-model (opt-in via CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) - AWS small-tier and Azure small-tier judges run in parallel, an AWS big-tier arbitrator resolves disagreement or single-provider failure. userNeed.title: Clinical auditors need related encounters automatically grouped into structured clinical episodes
userNeed.description: As a clinical auditor, I need related patient encounters to be automatically grouped into structured clinical episodes linked to pathway milestones, so that end-to-end patient journeys are visible for review and reporting without manual reconstruction from individual encounter records.

designInputs.title: Human-review gate blocking audit reporting use of unreviewed episode classifications
designInputs.description: The system SHALL prevent any episode classification from being included in an audit report or exported for downstream use unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit decision on that episode; the enforcement SHALL occur at the data query layer and SHALL be logged.

designInputs.title: Deterministic episode construction from related encounters
designInputs.description: The episode builder SHALL group encounters into episodes using the published grouping rules and SHALL attach pathway milestone states to each episode for review.

designInputs.title: Episode classification status schema (confirmed, excluded, inconclusive)
designInputs.description: The system SHALL assign each constructed episode a classification status of confirmed, excluded, or inconclusive based on the programme-defined classification rules, and SHALL display this status with a plain-language explanation to the reviewer.

designInputs.title: Episode timeline generation with pathway gap highlighting
designInputs.description: The system SHALL generate a timeline view for every constructed episode, showing each constituent encounter as a dated node with its associated pathway milestone and coded entities, with pathway sequence gaps visually highlighted.

designInputs.title: Episode classification method disclosure (rule-based vs LLM fallback) to reviewer
designInputs.description: The system SHALL record for every episode classification whether the decision was produced by the rule-based primary classifier or the LLM fallback, and SHALL surface this information to the reviewer on the episode card so they can calibrate their review effort accordingly.

designInputs.title: Episode classification accuracy gate: minimum 85% F1 against expert consensus
designInputs.description: The system SHALL measure episode classification accuracy as F1 against expert consensus on a frozen held-out test set of at least 500 episodes, and SHALL enforce an 85% minimum F1 quality gate that blocks production promotion of any episode classifier model that fails this threshold.

userNeed.title: Clinical safety officers need the review interface to require active evidence engagement to prevent automation bias
userNeed.description: As a clinical safety officer responsible for the human review gate, I need the review interface to be designed so that reviewers must actively engage with the clinical evidence before they can confirm an AI recommendation — not just acknowledge it — so that the human review step provides genuine clinical oversight rather than becoming a rubber stamp that automation bias reduces to a single click.

designInputs.title: Active evidence engagement gate before AI recommendation confirmation with urgency-criterion requirement
designInputs.description: The system SHALL render the AI recommendation confirm button as disabled until a reviewer has performed the configured minimum active evidence engagement actions, with high-urgency recommendations requiring explicit confirmation of the primary urgency criterion.

designInputs.title: RBAC enforcement for all AI output review and finalisation actions
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce role-based access control for all AI output review and finalisation actions, ensuring that no AI-generated entity, episode classification, quality alert, or clinical interpretation can be accepted, edited, or rejected without a user who has an appropriate assigned role performing the action.

designInputs.title: Reviewer engagement metrics logging and clinical safety officer monitoring view for automation bias detection
designInputs.description: The system SHALL log reviewer engagement metrics (time on evidence, findings reviewed, assertion changes, corrections) per review session, and SHALL provide a clinical safety officer monitoring view with low-engagement flags and configurable thresholds.

designInputs.title: Confirmation state reset on reviewer correction with mandatory re-engagement before re-confirmation
designInputs.description: The system SHALL reset the AI recommendation confirmation state and require reviewer re-engagement whenever a reviewer edits or removes a confirmed finding, ensuring the updated recommendation is reviewed before final confirmation.

userNeed.title: Clinical reviewers need plain-language AI interpretation of coded audit findings
userNeed.description: As a clinical reviewer working through a coded episode or audit alert, I need the system to generate a plain-language interpretation of what the coded data shows clinically, so that I can quickly understand the significance of a finding without needing to interpret raw SNOMED codes and interval calculations myself.

designInputs.title: Diagnostic and treatment recommendation exclusion from generated interpretations
designInputs.description: The system SHALL apply a post-generation content classification check to every AI-generated interpretation that detects and blocks outputs containing diagnostic conclusions, differential diagnoses, or treatment recommendations before the output is presented to any user or API consumer.

designInputs.title: Plain-language interpretation of coded findings for reviewers
designInputs.description: For each reviewer-selected coded finding, the system SHALL generate a plain-English interpretation at the configured reading level with linked source codes and explicit uncertainty when evidence is partial.

designInputs.title: Clinical significance framing: interpretation content bounded to structured input facts
designInputs.description: The system SHALL verify that every generated interpretation contains only clinical statements that are directly supported by the structured coded findings passed as input, and SHALL reject any interpretation that introduces clinical facts not present in the structured input set.

designInputs.title: Human-review gate blocking publication of AI-generated interpretations without reviewer decision
designInputs.description: The system SHALL prevent any AI-generated plain-language interpretation from being published, shared, exported, or surfaced to a downstream consumer unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit accept or reject decision against that specific interpretation; the gate SHALL be enforced at the API layer, not only in the UI.

designInputs.title: Confidence level displayed alongside each AI-generated interpretation
designInputs.description: The system SHALL include a confidence level in every generated plain-language interpretation, derived from the confidence scores of the underlying extracted entities, presented as both a numeric value and a human-readable tier label visible to the reviewer alongside the interpretation text.

userNeed.title: Engineering leads need the platform to follow Mizaic standard architecture and engineering design principles consistently across all services
userNeed.description: As an engineering lead responsible for the LEO Core AI platform, I need all services to follow Mizaic's standard architecture and engineering design principles consistently — workflow-as-data, configuration-as-data, async fire-and-track, AI models as graph nodes, secrets from Key Vault, and enforced code quality limits — so that any engineer can onboard to any part of the codebase with predictable patterns, and the system remains maintainable and auditable as it grows.

designInputs.title: Async fire-and-track job pattern with consistent status model for all long-running operations
designInputs.description: The system SHALL implement a consistent async fire-and-track pattern for all long-running operations, with 202 responses, job_id-based polling, persistent job state, and a uniform status model across all operation types.

designInputs.title: All secrets retrieved exclusively from Azure Key Vault with CI secret scanning and startup failure on missing secrets
designInputs.description: The system SHALL retrieve all secrets exclusively from Azure Key Vault using DefaultAzureCredential; no secrets SHALL appear in source code, committed environment files, or container images; services SHALL exit on secret retrieval failure.

designInputs.title: AI model configurations stored as graph nodes with runtime resolution and no hardcoded model names
designInputs.description: The system SHALL store all AI model configurations as AIModel nodes in the graph database and SHALL resolve model parameters at runtime from these nodes; no model names or provider parameters SHALL be hardcoded in application code.

designInputs.title: All pipeline and workflow logic defined as graph data and executed by a single generic executor
designInputs.description: The system SHALL define all pipeline and workflow logic as graph data stored as WorkflowDefinition and WorkflowStep nodes in the primary database, and SHALL execute all workflows through a single generic executor that reads step definitions at runtime, so that new workflows and pipeline configurations can be added by inserting graph data without any code changes or deployments.

designInputs.title: Unified LangGraph coding agent as the single execution path for all coding and pipeline jobs
designInputs.description: The system SHALL use a single unified LangGraph-based coding and audit agent as the exclusive runtime execution path for all clinical coding and pipeline jobs, with the training and runtime pipelines sharing the same post-processing functions, so that there is no divergence between paths and all coding outputs are traceable to a single versioned agent definition.

designInputs.title: CI-enforced code quality gates: black, flake8, ESLint with function and file length limits
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce automated code quality checks in CI: black formatting and flake8 linting for Python, ESLint for TypeScript, with function and file length limits; any violation blocks the merge pipeline.
